```{=html}
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&amp;family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<style>
/* ============================================================
   Duty Board — scheduling constraint solver
   Design language: transit/ops timetable board.
   Mono type for time + counts, grotesk for headings, Inter for UI.
   ============================================================ */

:root{
  --bg: #f4f6f9;
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --panel-2: #fbfcfd;
  --ink: #1b2430;
  --muted: #647186;
  --faint: #9aa5b4;
  --border: #dde3ea;
  --border-strong: #c7cfda;

  --accent: #0e7c7b;
  --accent-ink: #ffffff;
  --accent-soft: #e3f2f1;

  --preferred: #c9821a;
  --preferred-soft: #fbeed9;

  --danger: #c13b3b;
  --danger-soft: #fbe6e6;

  --radius-lg: 12px;
  --radius: 8px;
  --radius-sm: 5px;

  --shadow-pop: 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(20, 30, 45, 0.28);
  --shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,30,45,0.04);

  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", "Inter", sans-serif;
  --font-body: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
}

*, *::before, *::after{ box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body{
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

#duty-board *:focus-visible{
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

#duty-board{
  max-width: min(2200px, 96vw);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 28px 28px 64px;
}

#duty-board button{
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  cursor:pointer;
}
#duty-board input, #duty-board select, #duty-board textarea{
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* ---------------- Header ---------------- */
.db-header{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  row-gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.db-header .db-title-block{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; }
.db-header .db-eyebrow{
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.db-header h1{
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 26px;
  margin: 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.db-header .db-sub{
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.db-toolbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.db-tabs-bar{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  overflow-x:auto;
  flex: 1 1 260px;
  min-width: 160px;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--border-strong) transparent;
}
.db-tabs-bar::-webkit-scrollbar{ height:6px; }
.db-tabs-bar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{ background: var(--border-strong); border-radius:999px; }
.db-tabs-bar::-webkit-scrollbar-track{ background: transparent; }
.db-tab{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel);
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 550;
  white-space:nowrap;
  cursor:pointer;
  user-select:none;
  transition: border-color .12s ease, background .12s ease;
  position: relative;
}
.db-tab:hover{ border-color: var(--accent); }
.db-tab.active{ background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.db-tab.dragging{ opacity: .4; }
.db-tab .idx{ font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; opacity:.7; }
.db-tab-menu{
  position: fixed; z-index: 65;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  padding: 6px;
  width: 160px;
}
.db-tab-menu button{
  display:block; width:100%; text-align:left;
  padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border:none; background:transparent; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--ink);
}
.db-tab-menu button:hover{ background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.db-tab-menu button.danger:hover{ background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }

.btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel);
  color: var(--ink);
  padding: 8px 13px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 550;
  transition: border-color .12s ease, background .12s ease, transform .06s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn:hover{ border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.btn:active{ transform: translateY(1px); }
.btn-primary{
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-ink);
}
.btn-primary:hover{ background:#0b6564; border-color:#0b6564; color:var(--accent-ink); opacity: .96;}
.btn-icon{
  width: 34px; height: 34px; padding:0; justify-content:center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.btn-danger-outline{ border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--danger); }
.btn-danger-outline:hover{ background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); border-color:var(--danger);}
.btn.armed{ background: var(--preferred); border-color: var(--preferred); color:#fff; }
.btn.armed:hover{ background: var(--preferred); color:#fff; opacity:.9; }
.btn-sm{ padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 12px; }
.btn:disabled{ opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed; }
.btn:disabled:hover{ border-color: var(--border-strong); color: var(--ink); }

/* ---------------- Layout ---------------- */
.db-main-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 330px;
  gap: 18px;
  align-items:start;
}
.db-right-col{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:14px;
}
.db-panel{
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  min-height:0;
}
.db-panel-head{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.db-panel-head .head-actions{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:flex-end; }
.db-panel-head h2{
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 15px;
  margin:0;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.db-panel-head .db-panel-note{ font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

.db-info-icon{
  position:relative;
  width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size:10px; font-style:italic;
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  cursor:default;
}
.db-info-icon:hover, .db-info-icon:focus{ border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.db-info-tooltip{
  display:none;
  position:absolute; top:22px; right:0; z-index:40;
  width:220px;
  background: var(--ink); color:#fff;
  padding:9px 11px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size:11.5px; font-style:normal; line-height:1.45;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
}
.db-info-icon:hover .db-info-tooltip, .db-info-icon:focus .db-info-tooltip{ display:block; }

.db-settings-standalone-btn{
  align-self: stretch;
  justify-content:center;
}

/* ---------------- Chart ---------------- */
.db-chart-scroll{
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: 16px;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
}
.db-chart-scroll.full-view{ overflow-x: hidden; }
.db-chart-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-auto-rows: 40px;
  position: relative;
  width: max-content;
  min-width: 100%;
}
.db-chart-grid.full-view{ width: 100%; }
#chart-panel:fullscreen{ background: var(--panel); padding: 12px; overflow-y:auto; }
#chart-panel:-webkit-full-screen{ background: var(--panel); padding: 12px; overflow-y:auto; }
#duty-board:fullscreen{ background: var(--bg); padding: 20px; overflow-y:auto; max-width:none; width:100%; height:100%; }
#duty-board:-webkit-full-screen{ background: var(--bg); padding: 20px; overflow-y:auto; max-width:none; width:100%; height:100%; }
.db-corner{
  position: sticky; left:0; z-index:5;
  background: var(--panel);
  box-shadow: -40px 0 0 0 var(--panel);
  grid-column:1; grid-row:1;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
  display:flex; align-items:flex-end; padding: 0 10px 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--faint);
}
.db-time-head{
  grid-row: 1;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end;
  padding-bottom: 5px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted);
  position:relative;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.db-time-head:hover{ background: var(--accent-soft); }
.db-time-head.hour-start{ border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong); }
.db-time-head .tick{
  position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; left:0; width:1px;
}
.db-time-head .time-label{ writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); letter-spacing: .02em;}
.db-time-head.hour-start .time-label{ color: var(--ink); font-weight:600; }
.db-lock-badge{
  position:absolute; top:2px; right:2px; font-size:9px; line-height:1;
  opacity:0; transition: opacity .35s ease; pointer-events:none;
}
.db-row-label .db-lock-badge{ top:4px; right:4px; }
#duty-board.lock-display-on .db-lock-badge{ opacity:1; }
.db-lock-badge.force-show{ opacity:1 !important; }
.db-lock-badge.flash-show{ animation: lockFlashFade 2.6s ease forwards; }
@keyframes lockFlashFade{ 0%{opacity:1;} 65%{opacity:1;} 100%{opacity:0;} }

.db-row-label{
  grid-column: 1;
  position: sticky; left:0; z-index:4;
  background: var(--panel);
  box-shadow: -40px 0 0 0 var(--panel);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-right: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center;
  padding: 0 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .12s ease, outline .12s ease;
}
.db-row-label:hover{ background: var(--accent-soft); }
.db-row-label.highlight-red{ outline: 2px solid var(--danger); outline-offset: -2px; background: var(--danger-soft); }
.db-row-label.lock-preview{ box-shadow: -40px 0 0 0 var(--panel); }
.db-row-label .name{ font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.db-row-label .tags{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:3px; margin-top:3px; }
.db-row-label .tags.tags-hidden{ display:none; }
.db-row-resize-handle{
  grid-column:1;
  width:6px;
  justify-self:end;
  cursor: col-resize;
  z-index: 7;
  position:relative;
}
.db-row-resize-handle:hover, .db-row-resize-handle.dragging{ background: var(--accent); opacity:.55; }

.db-chart-footer{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding: 8px 16px 14px 16px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.db-chart-footer select{
  padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size:12px; background:#fff; color: var(--ink);
}

.db-cell{
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: transparent;
  padding:0; margin:0;
  position:relative;
}
.db-cell.hour-start{ border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong); }
.db-cell:hover{ background: var(--accent-soft); cursor:pointer; }
.db-cell.cell-flash{
  outline: 2px solid var(--danger);
  outline-offset: -2px;
  background: var(--danger-soft);
}
.db-cell.lock-preview, .db-block.lock-preview{
  background: rgba(22,163,74,0.16) !important;
  outline: 1px solid rgba(22,163,74,0.55);
  outline-offset: -1px;
}
.db-time-head.lock-preview{ background: rgba(22,163,74,0.22); }
.db-row-label.lock-preview{ background: rgba(22,163,74,0.16); }
#duty-board.lock-preview-active .db-lock-badge{ opacity:1; }

.db-block{
  position:relative;
  margin: 3px 2px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display:flex; align-items:center;
  padding: 0 8px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #fff;
  overflow:hidden;
  white-space:nowrap;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  z-index: 2;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
}
.db-block.confirmed{ box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); }
.db-block.rule-violated{ outline: 2px solid var(--danger); outline-offset: 1px; }
.db-block .resize-handle{
  position:absolute; top:0; right:0; bottom:0; width:9px;
  cursor: ew-resize;
}
.db-block .resize-handle:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
.db-block.resizing{ z-index: 12; }

.db-suggestion-box{
  position:relative;
  margin: 3px 2px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--border-strong);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  z-index: 2;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition: background .12s ease, border-color .12s ease;
}
.db-suggestion-box:hover{ background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); }
.db-suggestion-star{
  position:absolute;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height:1;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.25));
}

.db-tab.highlight-red{ outline: 2px solid var(--danger); outline-offset: 1px; }

/* ---------------- Dropdown (assign) ---------------- */
.db-dropdown{
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 60;
  width: 280px;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.db-dropdown-head{
  padding: 9px 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--panel-2);
}
.db-dropdown-list{ max-height: 320px; overflow-y:auto; }
.db-option{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: relative;
}
.db-option:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.db-option .dot{ width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }
.db-option .label{ flex:1; font-size:12.5px; }
.db-option .dur{ font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:var(--faint); }
.db-option .history-ratio{ font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:var(--faint); margin-left:4px; }
.db-option-head-actions{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.db-option-lock-toggle{
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong); background:#fff; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  width:22px; height:22px; font-size:11px; color: var(--muted); flex-shrink:0;
}
.db-option-lock-toggle.on{ background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.db-option.ok{ cursor:pointer; }
.db-option.ok:hover{ background: var(--accent-soft); }
.db-option.blocked{ color: var(--faint); cursor: not-allowed; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #f7f8fa, #f7f8fa 6px, #eef0f3 6px, #eef0f3 12px); }
.db-option.blocked .dot{ opacity:.35; }
.db-option .star-mark{ color: var(--preferred); font-size:12px; }
.db-option-tooltip{
  position:absolute; left: 100%; top:0; margin-left:8px;
  width: 220px;
  background: var(--ink); color:#fff;
  padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 11.5px; line-height:1.4;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  z-index: 70;
}

/* ---------------- Popups (accept/reject, remove) ---------------- */
.db-popup{
  position: fixed; z-index: 65;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  padding: 10px;
  width: 220px;
}
.db-popup .title{ font-size:12px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; }
.db-popup .rule-hint{ font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom:8px; line-height:1.4; }
.db-popup .row{ display:flex; gap:6px; }
.db-popup .row .btn{ flex:1; justify-content:center; }

/* ---------------- Decisions panel ---------------- */
.db-decisions-body{ padding: 12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto;}
.db-violation-card{
  border: 1.5px solid var(--danger);
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 9px 10px;
}
.db-violation-card .tag{
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color: var(--danger); font-weight:700; margin-bottom:3px; display:block;
}
.db-violation-card .txt{ font-size:12px; }

.db-decision-card{
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 9px 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  cursor:pointer;
  transition: border-color .12s ease;
}
.db-decision-card:hover{ border-color: var(--accent); }
.db-decision-card.hotspot{ border-color: var(--preferred); background: var(--preferred-soft); }
.db-decision-card.hotspot:hover{ border-color: var(--preferred); }
.db-decision-card .top-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; margin-bottom:3px;}
.db-decision-card .count-badge{
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; font-weight:700;
  background: var(--ink); color:#fff;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 8px;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.db-decision-card .count-badge.zero{ background: var(--danger); }
.db-decision-card .txt{ font-size: 12px; }
.db-empty-note{ color: var(--muted); font-size:12.5px; padding: 14px 4px; text-align:center; }

/* ---------------- Rules list ---------------- */
.db-rules-panel{ margin-top: 18px; }
.db-rules-toolbar{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--panel-2);
}
.db-rules-toolbar input[type="search"]{
  flex: 1 1 180px;
  min-width: 160px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  background: #fff;
}
.db-rules-toolbar select{
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 12px;
  background: #fff;
}
.db-rules-toolbar label.chk{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 5px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #fff;
}
.db-rules-toolbar label.chk input{ margin:0; }
.db-rules-toolbar .filter-group-label{
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color: var(--faint);
  margin-right: -3px;
}

.db-rules-body{ padding: 6px 16px 16px; }
.db-rules-section-title{
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin: 16px 0 8px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
}
.db-rules-section-title::after{ content:''; flex:1; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

.db-rule-row{
  display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px;
  padding: 10px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  background: var(--panel);
}
.db-rule-row.violated{ border-color: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--danger) inset; background: var(--danger-soft); }
.db-rule-row.inactive{ opacity: .5; }
.db-rule-row .effect-chip{
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight:700;
  padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:1px;
}
.db-rule-row .effect-chip.forbid{ background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
.db-rule-row .effect-chip.require{ background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.db-rule-row .rule-main{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
.db-rule-row .rule-text{ font-size: 12.5px; }
.db-rule-row .rule-meta{ margin-top:4px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:5px; align-items:center; }
.db-tag-chip{
  font-size: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono);
  background: #eef1f5; color: var(--muted);
  padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px;
}
.db-tag-pill{
  font-size: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono);
  padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px;
  display:inline-block;
  line-height: 1.5;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.db-rule-row .rule-actions{ display:flex; gap:5px; flex-shrink:0; align-items:center; }
.db-switch{ position:relative; width:32px; height:18px; flex-shrink:0; }
.db-switch input{ opacity:0; width:100%; height:100%; margin:0; position:absolute; cursor:pointer; }
.db-switch .track{ position:absolute; inset:0; background: var(--border-strong); border-radius:999px; transition:.12s; }
.db-switch .thumb{ position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; transition:.12s; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
.db-switch input:checked + .track{ background: var(--accent); }
.db-switch input:checked ~ .thumb{ left:16px; }

.db-icon-btn{
  width:26px; height:26px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border:1px solid var(--border); background:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  color: var(--muted); flex-shrink:0;
}
.db-icon-btn:hover{ border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

/* ---------------- Modal (settings) ---------------- */
.db-modal-overlay{
  position: fixed; inset:0; background: rgba(20,26,36,.5);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  z-index: 100; padding: 24px;
}
.db-modal{
  background: var(--panel);
  width: min(880px, 100%);
  max-height: min(720px, 92vh);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.db-modal-head{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.db-modal-head h2{ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size:17px; margin:0; }
.db-modal-tabs{ display:flex; gap:2px; padding: 10px 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.db-modal-tab{
  padding: 8px 14px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; color: var(--muted);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.db-modal-tab.active{
  color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft);
  border-color: var(--border);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent-soft);
}
.db-modal-body{ padding: 18px 20px; overflow-y:auto; flex:1; }
.db-modal-foot{ padding: 12px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; }

.db-field-row{ display:flex; gap:10px; margin-bottom:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-end;}
.db-field{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; }
.db-field label{ font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em;}
.db-field input[type="text"], .db-field input[type="number"], .db-field input[type="time"], .db-field select{
  padding: 7px 9px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size:12.5px; min-width: 140px;
}
.db-field input[type="color"]{ width:44px; height:32px; padding:2px; border:2px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); cursor:pointer; }
.db-field input[type="color"]:hover{ border-color: var(--accent); }
.db-color-field{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.db-color-field input[type="color"]{ width:36px; height:32px; padding:2px; border:2px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0; }
.db-color-field input[type="color"]:hover{ border-color: var(--accent); }
.db-hex-input{
  width:92px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:6px 8px; border:2px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.db-hex-input:focus{ border-color: var(--accent); outline:none; }
.db-field.checkbox{ flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.db-field.checkbox label{ text-transform:none; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12.5px; }
.db-field.grow{ flex:1; }

.db-mini-table{ width:100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top:10px;}
.db-mini-table th{ text-align:left; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size:10.5px; text-transform:uppercase; color: var(--faint); padding:6px 8px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--border-strong);}
.db-mini-table td{ padding:7px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); font-size:12.5px; vertical-align:middle;}
.db-mini-table tr:hover td{ background: var(--panel-2); }
.db-chip-set{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; }
.db-chip-toggle{
  font-size:10.5px; font-family: var(--font-mono); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong); background:#fff; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer;
}
.db-chip-toggle.on{ background: var(--accent); color:#fff; border-color: var(--accent); }

.db-rule-builder{
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 14px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.db-rule-builder h3{ font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 10px; font-family: var(--font-display); }
.db-relative-fields{
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-strong);
  margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 10px;
}
.db-rule-preview{
  font-size: 12.5px; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 8px 10px; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--ink);
}
.db-rule-preview .lbl{ font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:var(--faint); text-transform:uppercase; display:block; margin-bottom:2px;}

.db-toast{
  position: fixed; bottom: 22px; left:50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--ink); color:#fff; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12.5px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop); z-index: 200;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
}

.db-help-text{ font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height:1.5; background: var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding:9px 11px; margin-bottom:12px;}

@media (max-width: 980px){
  .db-main-row{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>
<div id="duty-board">

  <!-- Header -->
  <header class="db-header">
    <div class="db-title-block">
      <div>
        <div class="db-eyebrow">Duty Board</div>
        <h1 id="db-header-title">Shift &amp; Position Scheduler</h1>
        <div class="db-sub" id="db-header-sub">10:30 AM – 4:30 PM · 15‑minute slots</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="db-tabs-bar" id="schedule-tabs"></div>
    <div class="db-toolbar">
      <button class="btn" id="btn-save" title="Save schedule as .xlsx">Save .xlsx</button>
      <button class="btn" id="btn-load" title="Load schedule from .xlsx">Load .xlsx</button>
      <input type="file" id="file-input" accept=".xlsx" style="display:none" />
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-solve" title="Choose how Solve should fill the schedule">▶ Solve ▾</button>
      <button class="btn btn-icon" id="btn-fullscreen" title="Scheduler fullscreen (chart, decisions, and rules)">⛶</button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Main row: chart + decisions -->
  <div class="db-main-row">

    <!-- Schedule chart -->
    <section class="db-panel" id="chart-panel">
      <div class="db-panel-head">
        <h2>Schedule</h2>
        <div class="head-actions">
          <span class="db-panel-note" id="chart-range-note"></span>
          <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-full-view" title="Scale the whole chart to fit without side-scrolling">Full view</button>
          <button class="btn btn-icon" id="btn-chart-fullscreen" title="Fullscreen the chart (whole chart, scaled to fit)">⛶</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-chart-scroll">
        <div class="db-chart-grid" id="chart-grid"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-chart-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-toggle-tags">Person tags: on</button>
        <select id="hidden-people-select"><option value="">No people toggled off</option></select>
        <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-toggle-lock-display" title="When on, lock icons stay visible. When off, they flash briefly then only reappear on hover.">Lock display: off</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Decisions + advanced settings, stacked to match the chart's height -->
    <div class="db-right-col">
      <section class="db-panel" id="decisions-panel">
        <div class="db-panel-head">
          <h2>Decisions</h2>
          <div class="head-actions">
            <span class="db-panel-note" id="decisions-note"></span>
            <span class="db-info-icon" id="decisions-info-icon" tabindex="0">i
              <span class="db-info-tooltip">Decisions are based upon rules and ordered in priority of which ones simplify the number of possibilities the most — the "big decisions".</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="db-decisions-body" id="decisions-body"></div>
      </section>
      <button class="btn db-settings-standalone-btn" id="btn-settings" title="Advanced settings">⚙ Advanced settings</button>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Rules list -->
  <section class="db-panel db-rules-panel" id="rules-panel">
    <div class="db-panel-head">
      <h2>Rules</h2>
      <span class="db-panel-note" id="rules-count-note"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="db-rules-toolbar">
      <input type="search" id="rule-search" placeholder="Search rules, tags, names…" />
      <span class="filter-group-label">Person</span>
      <select id="filter-person">
        <option value="all">Any</option>
        <option value="unused">Not used</option>
        <option value="general">General (tag)</option>
        <option value="specific">Specific</option>
      </select>
      <span class="filter-group-label">Position</span>
      <select id="filter-position">
        <option value="all">Any</option>
        <option value="unused">Not used</option>
        <option value="general">General (tag)</option>
        <option value="specific">Specific</option>
      </select>
      <span class="filter-group-label">Time</span>
      <select id="filter-time">
        <option value="all">Any</option>
        <option value="unused">Not used</option>
        <option value="general">General (range)</option>
        <option value="specific">Specific</option>
      </select>
      <span class="filter-group-label">Tag</span>
      <select id="filter-rule-tag">
        <option value="all">All tags</option>
      </select>
      <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="filter-required" checked /> Required</label>
      <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="filter-preferred" checked /> Preferred</label>
      <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="filter-inactive" checked /> Show inactive</label>
    </div>
    <div class="db-rules-body" id="rules-body"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- Floating layers -->
  <div id="floating-layer"></div>
  <div id="toast-layer"></div>

  <!-- Settings modal -->
  <div class="db-modal-overlay" id="settings-overlay" style="display:none;">
    <div class="db-modal">
      <div class="db-modal-head">
        <h2>Advanced settings</h2>
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
          <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-settings-save" title="Save people, positions, tags, and time range to a file">Save settings</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btn-settings-load" title="Load people, positions, tags, and time range from a file">Load settings</button>
          <input type="file" id="settings-file-input" accept=".json" style="display:none" />
          <button class="db-icon-btn" id="btn-close-settings">✕</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-modal-tabs" id="modal-tabs">
        <div class="db-modal-tab active" data-tab="people">People</div>
        <div class="db-modal-tab" data-tab="positions">Positions</div>
        <div class="db-modal-tab" data-tab="tags">Tags</div>
        <div class="db-modal-tab" data-tab="rules">Rules</div>
        <div class="db-modal-tab" data-tab="time">Time range</div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-modal-body" id="modal-body"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   Duty Board — scheduling constraint solver
   Vanilla JS, no build step. All state lives in memory (`state`)
   and is rendered imperatively into the DOM on every change.
   State is also persisted to localStorage so nothing is lost on
   reload/close (this file is a standalone page once rendered by
   Quarto, not a sandboxed in-chat artifact, so localStorage is
   fully supported here).
   ============================================================ */

const SLOT_MINUTES = 5;
const STORAGE_KEY = 'duty-board-state-v1';
var idCounter = 1000;
function genId(prefix){ return `${prefix}_${(idCounter++).toString(36)}`; }
function range(a,b){ const out=[]; for(let i=a;i<=b;i++) out.push(i); return out; }
function cap(s){ return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+s.slice(1); }
function escapeHtml(str){
  return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
}

/* ---------------- Default demo state ---------------- */
var state = {
  settings: { startMinutes: 10*60+30, endMinutes: 16*60+30 },
  people: [
    { id:'p_alice', name:'Alice', tags:['tag_female','tag_bilingual'], hidden:false },
    { id:'p_bob',   name:'Bob',   tags:['tag_male'], hidden:false },
    { id:'p_carol', name:'Carol', tags:['tag_female'], hidden:false },
    { id:'p_dave',  name:'Dave',  tags:['tag_male'], hidden:false },
    { id:'p_eve',   name:'Eve',   tags:['tag_female','tag_bilingual'], hidden:false },
  ],
  positions: [
    { id:'pos_frontdesk',    name:'Front Desk',    durationMin:15, durationMax:15, preferredDuration:15, singlePerson:false, color:'#2563eb', textColor:'#FFFFFF', tags:[] },
    { id:'pos_setup',        name:'Setup Crew',    durationMin:30, durationMax:60, preferredDuration:45, singlePerson:false, color:'#ea580c', textColor:'#FFFFFF', tags:['tag_physical'] },
    { id:'pos_registration', name:'Registration',  durationMin:15, durationMax:15, preferredDuration:15, singlePerson:true,  color:'#16a34a', textColor:'#FFFFFF', tags:[] },
    { id:'pos_techsupport',  name:'Tech Support',  durationMin:45, durationMax:45, preferredDuration:45, singlePerson:true,  color:'#7c3aed', textColor:'#FFFFFF', tags:[] },
    { id:'pos_breakrelief',  name:'Break Relief',  durationMin:15, durationMax:15, preferredDuration:15, singlePerson:false, color:'#db2777', textColor:'#FFFFFF', tags:[] },
  ],
  tags: [
    { id:'tag_male',      name:'Male',                 category:'person',   highlightColor:'#E4E7FB', textColor:'#3730A3' },
    { id:'tag_female',    name:'Female',               category:'person',   highlightColor:'#F6E4F5', textColor:'#86198F' },
    { id:'tag_bilingual', name:'Bilingual',             category:'person',   highlightColor:'#DCFCE7', textColor:'#166534' },
    { id:'tag_physical',  name:'Physically demanding',  category:'position', highlightColor:'#FDE7D9', textColor:'#9A3412' },
    { id:'tag_skill',     name:'Skill',                 category:'rule',     highlightColor:'#E0F2FE', textColor:'#0369A1' },
    { id:'tag_coverage',  name:'Coverage',              category:'rule',     highlightColor:'#FCE7F3', textColor:'#9D174D' },
    { id:'tag_comfort',   name:'Comfort',               category:'rule',     highlightColor:'#EDE9FE', textColor:'#5B21B6' },
    { id:'tag_language',  name:'Language',              category:'rule',     highlightColor:'#FEF3C7', textColor:'#92400E' },
    { id:'tag_fairness',  name:'Fairness',              category:'rule',     highlightColor:'#E4E7FB', textColor:'#3730A3' },
    { id:'tag_pairing',   name:'Pairing',               category:'rule',     highlightColor:'#DCFCE7', textColor:'#166534' },
    { id:'tag_integrity', name:'Integrity',             category:'rule',     highlightColor:'#FEE2E2', textColor:'#991B1B' },
  ],
  schedules: [
    {
      id: 'sched_1',
      name: 'Schedule 1',
      assignments: [],
      rejectedSuggestions: new Set(),
      lockedPeople: new Set(),
      lockedSlots: new Set(),
      lockedCells: new Set(),
      rules: [
        { id:'rule_0', kind:'standard', strength:'required',  effect:'require', active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'id', value:'p_bob'}, position:{mode:'id', value:'pos_breakrelief'}, slot:{mode:'id', value:30}, tags:['tag_coverage'] },
        { id:'rule_1', kind:'standard', strength:'required',  effect:'forbid',  active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'id', value:'p_carol'}, position:{mode:'id', value:'pos_setup'}, slot:{mode:'any'}, tags:['tag_skill'] },
        { id:'rule_2', kind:'standard', strength:'required',  effect:'require', active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'any'}, position:{mode:'id', value:'pos_registration'}, slot:{mode:'id', value:0}, tags:['tag_coverage'] },
        { id:'rule_3', kind:'standard', strength:'preferred', effect:'forbid',  active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'tag', value:'tag_female'}, position:{mode:'tag', value:'tag_physical'}, slot:{mode:'any'}, tags:['tag_comfort'] },
        { id:'rule_4', kind:'standard', strength:'preferred', effect:'require', active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'id', value:'p_alice'}, position:{mode:'id', value:'pos_techsupport'}, slot:{mode:'id', value:12}, tags:['tag_skill'] },
        { id:'rule_5', kind:'standard', strength:'preferred', effect:'require', active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'tag', value:'tag_bilingual'}, position:{mode:'id', value:'pos_frontdesk'}, slot:{mode:'range', start:0, end:11}, tags:['tag_language'] },
        { id:'rule_6', kind:'relative', strength:'preferred', effect:'require', active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'id', value:'p_alice'}, position:{mode:'any'}, slot:{mode:'any'},
          relative:{ type:'together', otherPerson:{mode:'id', value:'p_bob'} }, tags:['tag_pairing'] },
        { id:'rule_7', kind:'relative', strength:'required', effect:'forbid', active:true, nickname:'',
          person:{mode:'any'}, position:{mode:'tag', value:'tag_physical'}, slot:{mode:'any'},
          relative:{ type:'consecutive', maxConsecutive:2 }, tags:['tag_fairness'] },
        { id:'rule_8', kind:'relative', strength:'required', effect:'forbid', active:true, nickname:'No mutual swaps',
          person:{mode:'any'}, position:{mode:'any'}, slot:{mode:'any'},
          relative:{ type:'swap' }, tags:['tag_integrity'] },
      ],
    },
  ],
  activeScheduleId: 'sched_1',
  assignments: null,
  rules: null,
  rejectedSuggestions: null,
  lockedPeople: null,
  lockedSlots: null,
  lockedCells: null,
};
state.assignments = state.schedules[0].assignments;
state.rules = state.schedules[0].rules;
state.rejectedSuggestions = state.schedules[0].rejectedSuggestions;
state.lockedPeople = state.schedules[0].lockedPeople;
state.lockedSlots = state.schedules[0].lockedSlots;
state.lockedCells = state.schedules[0].lockedCells;

var rulesFocusPersonId = null;
var rulesFocusSlotIndex = null;
var showPersonTags = true;
var fullViewMode = false;
var resizeDrag = null; // { assignmentId, startX, startSlotCount, cellWidth }
var rowLabelWidth = 150;
var rowLabelResizeDrag = null;
var lockDisplayMode = false;
var pendingSwap = null; // { mode: 'names'|'rows', personId }

const NEW_TAG_PALETTE = [
  {bg:'#E4E7FB', text:'#3730A3'}, {bg:'#F6E4F5', text:'#86198F'},
  {bg:'#DCFCE7', text:'#166534'}, {bg:'#FDE7D9', text:'#9A3412'},
  {bg:'#E0F2FE', text:'#0369A1'}, {bg:'#FCE7F3', text:'#9D174D'},
  {bg:'#EDE9FE', text:'#5B21B6'}, {bg:'#FEF3C7', text:'#92400E'},
];
function nextTagPalette(){ return NEW_TAG_PALETTE[state.tags.length % NEW_TAG_PALETTE.length]; }

/* ================================================================
   SCHEDULE (TAB) MANAGEMENT
   ================================================================ */
function activeSchedule(){ return state.schedules.find(s=>s.id===state.activeScheduleId); }

function setActiveSchedule(id){
  const sched = state.schedules.find(s=>s.id===id);
  if(!sched) return;
  state.activeScheduleId = id;
  state.assignments = sched.assignments;
  state.rules = sched.rules;
  state.rejectedSuggestions = sched.rejectedSuggestions;
  state.lockedPeople = sched.lockedPeople;
  state.lockedSlots = sched.lockedSlots;
  state.lockedCells = sched.lockedCells;
  renderAll();
  const overlay = document.getElementById('settings-overlay');
  if(overlay && overlay.style.display==='flex'){
    const activeTab = document.querySelector('.db-modal-tab.active');
    if(activeTab) switchModalTab(activeTab.dataset.tab);
  }
}
function createSchedule(name, seed){
  const sched = {
    id: genId('sched'),
    name: name || `Schedule ${state.schedules.length+1}`,
    assignments: (seed && seed.assignments) || [],
    rules: (seed && seed.rules) || [],
    rejectedSuggestions: (seed && seed.rejectedSuggestions) || new Set(),
    lockedPeople: (seed && seed.lockedPeople) || new Set(),
    lockedSlots: (seed && seed.lockedSlots) || new Set(),
    lockedCells: (seed && seed.lockedCells) || new Set(),
  };
  state.schedules.push(sched);
  return sched;
}
function cellKeyFor(personId, slotIndex){ return `${personId}|${slotIndex}`; }
function isCellLocked(sched, personId, slotIndex){
  return sched.lockedPeople.has(personId) || sched.lockedSlots.has(slotIndex) || sched.lockedCells.has(cellKeyFor(personId, slotIndex));
}
function cloneActiveSchedule(mode){
  const src = activeSchedule();
  let assignments;
  if(mode==='unlocked'){
    assignments = src.assignments.filter(a=>{
      const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
      return occ.some(s=>isCellLocked(src, a.personId, s));
    }).map(a=>({ ...a, id:genId('asg') }));
  } else {
    assignments = src.assignments.map(a=>({ ...a, id:genId('asg') }));
  }
  const cloned = createSchedule(`${src.name} (copy)`, {
    assignments,
    rules: src.rules.map(r=>({ ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(r)), id:genId('rule') })),
    rejectedSuggestions: new Set(src.rejectedSuggestions),
    lockedPeople: new Set(src.lockedPeople),
    lockedSlots: new Set(src.lockedSlots),
    lockedCells: new Set(src.lockedCells),
  });
  setActiveSchedule(cloned.id);
}
function deleteSchedule(id){
  if(state.schedules.length<=1){ alert('At least one schedule must remain.'); return; }
  const idx = state.schedules.findIndex(s=>s.id===id);
  if(idx<0) return;
  state.schedules.splice(idx,1);
  if(state.activeScheduleId===id){
    setActiveSchedule(state.schedules[Math.max(0, idx-1)].id);
  } else {
    renderAll();
  }
}
function reorderSchedule(fromId, toId){
  const fromIdx = state.schedules.findIndex(s=>s.id===fromId);
  const toIdx = state.schedules.findIndex(s=>s.id===toId);
  if(fromIdx<0 || toIdx<0 || fromIdx===toIdx) return;
  const [item] = state.schedules.splice(fromIdx,1);
  state.schedules.splice(toIdx,0,item);
  renderAll();
}

/* ================================================================
   PERSISTENCE (localStorage)
   ================================================================ */
function persist(){
  try{
    const payload = {
      people: state.people, positions: state.positions, tags: state.tags, settings: state.settings,
      schedules: state.schedules.map(s=>({
        id:s.id, name:s.name, assignments:s.assignments, rules:s.rules,
        rejectedSuggestions: Array.from(s.rejectedSuggestions),
        lockedPeople: Array.from(s.lockedPeople), lockedSlots: Array.from(s.lockedSlots), lockedCells: Array.from(s.lockedCells),
      })),
      activeScheduleId: state.activeScheduleId,
    };
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
  }catch(e){ console.warn('Could not persist Duty Board state', e); }
}
function loadPersisted(){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if(!raw) return false;
    const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.schedules) || payload.schedules.length===0) return false;
    state.people = payload.people || [];
    state.positions = payload.positions || [];
    state.tags = payload.tags || [];
    state.settings = payload.settings || state.settings;
    state.schedules = payload.schedules.map(s=>({
      id:s.id, name:s.name, assignments:s.assignments||[], rules:s.rules||[],
      rejectedSuggestions: new Set(s.rejectedSuggestions||[]),
      lockedPeople: new Set(s.lockedPeople||[]), lockedSlots: new Set(s.lockedSlots||[]), lockedCells: new Set(s.lockedCells||[]),
    }));
    state.activeScheduleId = (payload.activeScheduleId && state.schedules.some(s=>s.id===payload.activeScheduleId))
      ? payload.activeScheduleId : state.schedules[0].id;
    const sched = activeSchedule();
    state.assignments = sched.assignments;
    state.rules = sched.rules;
    state.rejectedSuggestions = sched.rejectedSuggestions;
    state.lockedPeople = sched.lockedPeople;
    state.lockedSlots = sched.lockedSlots;
    state.lockedCells = sched.lockedCells;
    return true;
  }catch(e){ console.warn('Could not load persisted Duty Board state', e); return false; }
}

/* ---------------- Time / slot helpers ---------------- */
function getSlots(){
  const { startMinutes, endMinutes } = state.settings;
  const out = [];
  let idx = 0;
  for(let m=startMinutes; m<endMinutes; m+=SLOT_MINUTES){
    out.push({ index: idx, minutes: m, label: formatTime(m) });
    idx++;
  }
  return out;
}
function formatTime(mins){
  let h = Math.floor(mins/60), m = mins%60;
  const ampm = h>=12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  let h12 = h%12; if(h12===0) h12=12;
  return `${h12}:${m.toString().padStart(2,'0')} ${ampm}`;
}
function formatTimeShort(mins){
  let h = Math.floor(mins/60), m = mins%60;
  const ampm = h>=12 ? 'p' : 'a';
  let h12 = h%12; if(h12===0) h12=12;
  return m===0 ? `${h12}${ampm}` : `${h12}:${m.toString().padStart(2,'0')}${ampm}`;
}
function isHourMark(slot, i){ return slot.minutes % 60 === 0 || i===0; }
function minutesToTimeInput(m){ const h=Math.floor(m/60), mm=m%60; return `${h.toString().padStart(2,'0')}:${mm.toString().padStart(2,'0')}`; }
function timeInputToMinutes(v){ const [h,m] = v.split(':').map(Number); return h*60+m; }

/* ---------------- Lookups ---------------- */
function personName(id){ const p = state.people.find(p=>p.id===id); return p ? p.name : '(unknown person)'; }
function positionName(id){ const p = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===id); return p ? p.name : '(unknown position)'; }
function tagName(id){ const t = state.tags.find(t=>t.id===id); return t ? t.name : id; }
function tagChipHtml(tagId){
  const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===tagId);
  if(!t) return '';
  const bg = t.highlightColor || '#eef1f5';
  const fg = t.textColor || '#647186';
  return `<span class="db-tag-pill" style="background:${bg};color:${fg};">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span>`;
}
function positionDurationSlots(positionId){
  const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===positionId);
  if(!pos) return 1;
  const minMin = pos.durationMin!==undefined ? pos.durationMin : (pos.durationMinutes||15);
  const maxMin = pos.durationMax!==undefined ? pos.durationMax : minMin;
  const prefMin = pos.preferredDuration!==undefined ? pos.preferredDuration : minMin;
  const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(prefMin, minMin), maxMin);
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(clamped/SLOT_MINUTES));
}
function positionMinDurationSlots(positionId){
  const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===positionId);
  const minMin = pos ? (pos.durationMin!==undefined?pos.durationMin:(pos.durationMinutes||15)) : SLOT_MINUTES;
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(minMin/SLOT_MINUTES));
}
function positionMaxDurationSlots(positionId){
  const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===positionId);
  if(!pos) return 1;
  const maxMin = pos.durationMax!==undefined ? pos.durationMax : (pos.durationMin!==undefined?pos.durationMin:pos.durationMinutes||15);
  return Math.max(positionMinDurationSlots(positionId), Math.round(maxMin/SLOT_MINUTES));
}
function assignmentOccupiesSlots(a){ return range(a.startSlot, a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1); }

/* How many of the schedules BEFORE the active one (in tab order) had this exact
   person/position/startSlot assignment — used for the "2/4" hint in the assign dropdown. */
function historicalRatio(personId, positionId, startSlot){
  const activeIdx = state.schedules.findIndex(s=>s.id===state.activeScheduleId);
  const preceding = state.schedules.slice(0, activeIdx);
  if(preceding.length===0) return null;
  const matches = preceding.filter(s=>s.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===personId && a.positionId===positionId && a.startSlot===startSlot)).length;
  return { matches, total: preceding.length };
}

/* ---------------- Rule target matching ---------------- */
function personMatchesTarget(target, personId){
  if(!target) return true;
  if(target.mode==='any'){
    const reqTags = target.requiredTags || [];
    const prohTags = target.prohibitedTags || [];
    if(reqTags.length===0 && prohTags.length===0) return true;
    const p = state.people.find(p=>p.id===personId);
    if(!p) return false;
    if(!reqTags.every(t=>p.tags.includes(t))) return false;
    if(prohTags.some(t=>p.tags.includes(t))) return false;
    return true;
  }
  if(target.mode==='id') return target.value===personId;
  if(target.mode==='tag'){ const p = state.people.find(p=>p.id===personId); return !!p && p.tags.includes(target.value); }
  return false;
}
function positionMatchesTarget(target, positionId){
  if(!target || target.mode==='any') return true;
  if(target.mode==='id') return target.value===positionId;
  if(target.mode==='tag'){ const p = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===positionId); return !!p && p.tags.includes(target.value); }
  return false;
}
function slotMatchesTarget(target, slotIndex){
  if(!target || target.mode==='any') return true;
  if(target.mode==='id') return target.value===slotIndex;
  if(target.mode==='range') return slotIndex>=target.start && slotIndex<=target.end;
  return false;
}
function targetSlotIndices(target, totalSlots){
  if(!target || target.mode==='any') return range(0, totalSlots-1);
  if(target.mode==='id') return [target.value];
  if(target.mode==='range') return range(Math.max(0,target.start), Math.min(totalSlots-1,target.end));
  return [];
}
function candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget(target, durSlots, totalSlots){
  const maxStart = totalSlots - durSlots;
  if(maxStart<0) return [];
  if(!target || target.mode==='any') return range(0, maxStart);
  if(target.mode==='id'){
    const lo = Math.max(0, target.value-durSlots+1), hi = Math.min(maxStart, target.value);
    return lo<=hi ? range(lo,hi) : [];
  }
  if(target.mode==='range'){
    const lo = Math.max(0, target.start-durSlots+1), hi = Math.min(maxStart, target.end);
    return lo<=hi ? range(lo,hi) : [];
  }
  return [];
}

/* ---------------- Rule label generation ---------------- */
function targetDescription(target, kind){
  if(!target) return kind==='person' ? 'anyone' : 'any position';
  if(target.mode==='any'){
    if(kind!=='person') return 'any position';
    const reqTags = target.requiredTags || [], prohTags = target.prohibitedTags || [];
    if(reqTags.length===0 && prohTags.length===0) return 'anyone';
    const parts = [];
    if(reqTags.length) parts.push(`tagged ${reqTags.map(t=>`"${tagName(t)}"`).join(' & ')}`);
    if(prohTags.length) parts.push(`not tagged ${prohTags.map(t=>`"${tagName(t)}"`).join(' or ')}`);
    const countRange = target.count || {min:1, max:1};
    const countPhrase = (countRange.min===countRange.max)
      ? `${countRange.min} ${countRange.min===1?'person':'people'}`
      : `${countRange.min}–${countRange.max} people`;
    return `${countPhrase} ${parts.join(', ')}`;
  }
  if(target.mode==='id') return kind==='person' ? personName(target.value) : positionName(target.value);
  if(target.mode==='tag'){
    const t = state.tags.find(t=>t.id===target.value);
    const n = t ? t.name : '?';
    return kind==='person' ? `people tagged "${n}"` : `positions tagged "${n}"`;
  }
  return '?';
}
function slotDescription(target){
  const slots = getSlots();
  if(!target || target.mode==='any') return 'at any time';
  if(target.mode==='id') return `at ${slots[target.value] ? slots[target.value].label : '?'}`;
  if(target.mode==='range') return `from ${slots[target.start] ? slots[target.start].label : '?'} to ${slots[target.end] ? slots[target.end].label : '?'}`;
  return '';
}
function ruleLabel(rule){
  const p = targetDescription(rule.person, 'person');
  const pos = targetDescription(rule.position, 'position');
  const t = slotDescription(rule.slot);

  if(rule.kind!=='relative'){
    const verb = rule.effect==='forbid' ? 'cannot be scheduled' : 'must be scheduled';
    return `${cap(p)} ${verb} for ${pos}, ${t}.`;
  }
  const rel = rule.relative || {};
  const modal = rule.effect==='forbid' ? 'cannot' : 'must';
  if(rel.type==='sequence'){
    const other = targetDescription(rel.otherPosition, 'position');
    const gapPhrase = (rel.maxGapMinutes!==undefined && rel.maxGapMinutes!==null && rel.maxGapMinutes!=='') ? ` within ${rel.maxGapMinutes} minutes` : '';
    if(rel.order==='either'){
      return `${cap(p)} ${modal} be scheduled for ${pos}${gapPhrase} of being scheduled for ${other}.`;
    }
    const order = rel.order==='before' ? 'before' : 'after';
    return `${cap(p)} ${modal} be scheduled for ${pos} ${order} being scheduled for ${other}${gapPhrase}.`;
  }
  if(rel.type==='together'){
    const other = targetDescription(rel.otherPerson, 'person');
    const posClause = (rule.position && rule.position.mode!=='any') ? ` (specifically ${pos})` : '';
    return `${cap(p)} ${modal} be scheduled for the same position and time as ${other}${posClause}.`;
  }
  if(rel.type==='consecutive'){
    if(rel.measure==='minutes'){
      const n = rel.maxConsecutiveMinutes || 30;
      return `${cap(p)} ${modal} have more than ${n} consecutive minutes of ${pos}.`;
    }
    const n = rel.maxConsecutive || 2;
    return `${cap(p)} ${modal} be scheduled for ${pos} in ${n} consecutive slots.`;
  }
  if(rel.type==='totalLimit'){
    const isMinutes = rel.measure==='minutes';
    const n = rel.max || (isMinutes?45:2);
    return `${cap(p)} ${modal} have more than ${n} ${isMinutes?'total minutes':'total occurrences'} of ${pos} in this schedule.`;
  }
  if(rel.type==='crossSchedule'){
    const n = rel.maxRepeat || 2;
    return `${cap(p)} ${modal} repeat the same ${pos} assignment (same time slot) in ${n} consecutive schedules (viewing order).`;
  }
  if(rel.type==='swap'){
    return `${cap(p)} cannot go from any position X to any position Y when anyone is coming from position Y to position X (no mutual swaps).`;
  }
  return `${cap(p)} ${rule.effect==='forbid'?'cannot':'must'} be scheduled for ${pos}, ${t}.`;
}

/* ---------------- Relative-rule matching (hard constraint side) ---------------- */
function withinGap(gapSlots, maxGapMinutes){
  if(maxGapMinutes===undefined || maxGapMinutes===null || maxGapMinutes==='') return true;
  const maxGapSlots = Math.ceil(Number(maxGapMinutes)/SLOT_MINUTES);
  return gapSlots<=maxGapSlots;
}
function orderRelationHolds(earlierEnd, laterStart, maxGapMinutes){
  if(laterStart<=earlierEnd) return false;
  const gap = laterStart-earlierEnd-1;
  return withinGap(gap, maxGapMinutes);
}
function violatesSequenceRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots, excludeId){
  if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
  const order = rule.relative.order || 'after';
  const maxGap = rule.relative.maxGapMinutes;
  const otherTarget = rule.relative.otherPosition || {mode:'any'};
  const matchesPrimary = positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId);
  const matchesOther = positionMatchesTarget(otherTarget, positionId);
  if(!matchesPrimary && !matchesOther) return false;

  const candStart = occupiedSlots[0], candEnd = occupiedSlots[occupiedSlots.length-1];
  const others = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId && a.id!==excludeId);

  function relationHolds(otherStart, otherEnd, candidateIsPrimary){
    if(order==='after'){
      return candidateIsPrimary ? orderRelationHolds(otherEnd, candStart, maxGap) : orderRelationHolds(candEnd, otherStart, maxGap);
    }
    if(order==='before'){
      return candidateIsPrimary ? orderRelationHolds(candEnd, otherStart, maxGap) : orderRelationHolds(otherEnd, candStart, maxGap);
    }
    return orderRelationHolds(otherEnd, candStart, maxGap) || orderRelationHolds(candEnd, otherStart, maxGap);
  }

  if(matchesPrimary){
    for(const a of others){
      if(!positionMatchesTarget(otherTarget, a.positionId)) continue;
      if(relationHolds(a.startSlot, a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1, true)) return true;
    }
  }
  if(matchesOther){
    for(const a of others){
      if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId)) continue;
      if(relationHolds(a.startSlot, a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1, false)) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
function violatesTogetherRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots, excludeId){
  const otherTarget = rule.relative.otherPerson || {mode:'any'};
  const matchesPrimary = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId);
  const matchesOther = personMatchesTarget(otherTarget, personId);
  if(!matchesPrimary && !matchesOther) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;

  const counterpartTarget = matchesPrimary ? otherTarget : rule.person;
  const counterpartIds = state.people.filter(p=>p.id!==personId && personMatchesTarget(counterpartTarget, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
  return state.assignments.some(a=>
    a.id!==excludeId && counterpartIds.includes(a.personId) && a.positionId===positionId &&
    assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>occupiedSlots.includes(s))
  );
}
function violatesConsecutiveRule(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots, excludeId){
  if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
  const measure = rule.relative.measure || 'count';
  const existing = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId && a.id!==excludeId);
  const items = [
    ...existing.map(a=>({ startSlot:a.startSlot, slotCount:a.slotCount, matches: positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId) })),
    { startSlot, slotCount:durSlots, matches:true },
  ].sort((a,b)=>a.startSlot-b.startSlot);

  if(measure==='minutes'){
    const maxMinutes = rule.relative.maxConsecutiveMinutes || 30;
    let streakMinutes=0, best=0, prevEnd=null;
    for(const item of items){
      const end = item.startSlot+item.slotCount-1;
      const touches = prevEnd!==null && item.startSlot===prevEnd+1;
      streakMinutes = item.matches ? (touches ? streakMinutes+item.slotCount*SLOT_MINUTES : item.slotCount*SLOT_MINUTES) : 0;
      best = Math.max(best, streakMinutes);
      prevEnd = end;
    }
    return best>maxMinutes;
  }
  const maxConsecutive = rule.relative.maxConsecutive || 2;
  let streak=0, best=0, prevEnd=null;
  for(const item of items){
    const end = item.startSlot+item.slotCount-1;
    const touches = prevEnd!==null && item.startSlot===prevEnd+1;
    streak = item.matches ? (touches ? streak+1 : 1) : 0;
    best = Math.max(best, streak);
    prevEnd = end;
  }
  return best>=maxConsecutive;
}
function violatesTotalLimitRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots, excludeId){
  if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
  const measure = rule.relative.measure || 'count';
  const maxVal = rule.relative.max || (measure==='minutes' ? 45 : 2);
  const matching = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.id!==excludeId && a.personId===personId && positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId));
  if(measure==='minutes'){
    const totalMinutes = matching.reduce((sum,a)=>sum+a.slotCount*SLOT_MINUTES, 0) + occupiedSlots.length*SLOT_MINUTES;
    return totalMinutes>maxVal;
  }
  const totalCount = matching.length+1;
  return totalCount>maxVal;
}
function violatesCrossScheduleRule(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots){
  if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
  const maxRepeat = rule.relative.maxRepeat || 2;
  const activeIdx = state.schedules.findIndex(s=>s.id===state.activeScheduleId);
  let streak = 1;
  for(let i=activeIdx-1; i>=0; i--){
    const match = state.schedules[i].assignments.some(a=>
      a.personId===personId && a.positionId===positionId && a.startSlot===startSlot && a.slotCount===durSlots);
    if(match) streak++; else break;
  }
  return streak>=maxRepeat;
}
/* Does some OTHER person (excluding excludePersonId) have an assignment at fromPos
   that ends before an assignment they also have at toPos begins? (i.e. that person
   goes fromPos -> toPos, the mirror image of the candidate's transition.) */
function hasOppositeTransition(excludePersonId, fromPos, toPos, excludeId){
  const others = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId!==excludePersonId && a.id!==excludeId);
  const fromAssignments = others.filter(a=>a.positionId===fromPos);
  const toAssignments = others.filter(a=>a.positionId===toPos);
  for(const f of fromAssignments){
    const fEnd = f.startSlot+f.slotCount-1;
    for(const t of toAssignments){
      if(t.personId===f.personId && t.startSlot>fEnd) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
function violatesSwapRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots, excludeId){
  if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
  const candStart = occupiedSlots[0], candEnd = occupiedSlots[occupiedSlots.length-1];
  const myOthers = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId && a.id!==excludeId);

  // Candidate is the LATER leg (Y) of a P1 -> positionId transition for this person.
  for(const a of myOthers){
    const aEnd = a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1;
    if(aEnd<candStart && a.positionId!==positionId){
      if(hasOppositeTransition(personId, positionId, a.positionId, excludeId)) return true;
    }
  }
  // Candidate is the EARLIER leg (X) of a positionId -> P2 transition for this person.
  for(const a of myOthers){
    if(a.startSlot>candEnd && a.positionId!==positionId){
      if(hasOppositeTransition(personId, a.positionId, positionId, excludeId)) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
function findSwapCounterparts(personId, positionId, occupiedSlots, excludeId){
  const candStart = occupiedSlots[0], candEnd = occupiedSlots[occupiedSlots.length-1];
  const myOthers = state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId && a.id!==excludeId);
  const involved = [];
  for(const a of myOthers){
    const aEnd = a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1;
    if(aEnd<candStart && a.positionId!==positionId && hasOppositeTransition(personId, positionId, a.positionId, excludeId)){
      involved.push(a.id);
      state.assignments.filter(b=>b.personId!==personId && b.id!==excludeId && b.positionId===positionId).forEach(b=>{
        const bEnd = b.startSlot+b.slotCount-1;
        const hasReturn = state.assignments.some(c=>c.personId===b.personId && c.positionId===a.positionId && c.startSlot>bEnd);
        if(hasReturn) involved.push(b.id);
      });
    }
  }
  return involved;
}

function describeHighlights(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots){
  const out = { personIds:[], slots:[], assignmentIds:[], scheduleIds:[] };
  if(rule.person && rule.person.mode!=='any') out.personIds.push(personId);
  if(!rule.kind || rule.kind!=='relative'){
    if(rule.slot && rule.slot.mode!=='any') out.slots = occupiedSlots.slice();
    return out;
  }
  const rel = rule.relative || {};
  if(rel.type==='sequence'){
    const otherTarget = rel.otherPosition || {mode:'any'};
    state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId && positionMatchesTarget(otherTarget, a.positionId))
      .forEach(a=>out.assignmentIds.push(a.id));
  } else if(rel.type==='together'){
    const matchesPrimary = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId);
    const counterpartTarget = matchesPrimary ? (rel.otherPerson||{mode:'any'}) : rule.person;
    const counterpartIds = state.people.filter(p=>p.id!==personId && personMatchesTarget(counterpartTarget, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
    out.personIds.push(...counterpartIds);
    state.assignments.filter(a=>counterpartIds.includes(a.personId) && a.positionId===positionId && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>occupiedSlots.includes(s)))
      .forEach(a=>out.assignmentIds.push(a.id));
  } else if(rel.type==='consecutive'){
    state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId && positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId) &&
      (a.startSlot+a.slotCount===occupiedSlots[0] || occupiedSlots[occupiedSlots.length-1]+1===a.startSlot)
    ).forEach(a=>out.assignmentIds.push(a.id));
  } else if(rel.type==='totalLimit'){
    state.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId===personId && positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId))
      .forEach(a=>out.assignmentIds.push(a.id));
  } else if(rel.type==='crossSchedule'){
    const activeIdx = state.schedules.findIndex(s=>s.id===state.activeScheduleId);
    const durSlots = occupiedSlots.length;
    for(let i=activeIdx-1;i>=0;i--){
      const match = state.schedules[i].assignments.some(a=>
        a.personId===personId && a.positionId===positionId && a.startSlot===occupiedSlots[0] && a.slotCount===durSlots);
      if(match) out.scheduleIds.push(state.schedules[i].id); else break;
    }
  } else if(rel.type==='swap'){
    findSwapCounterparts(personId, positionId, occupiedSlots, null).forEach(id=>out.assignmentIds.push(id));
  }
  return out;
}

/* ---------------- Hard constraint checking ---------------- */
function isValidPlacement(personId, positionId, startSlot, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const slots = getSlots();
  const durSlots = opts.durSlots!==undefined ? opts.durSlots : positionDurationSlots(positionId);
  const excludeId = opts.excludeAssignmentId;
  if(startSlot<0 || startSlot+durSlots>slots.length){
    const remain = Math.max(0, slots.length-startSlot)*SLOT_MINUTES;
    return { ok:false, reason:`Doesn't fit — needs ${durSlots*SLOT_MINUTES} min but only ${remain} min remain in the schedule.` };
  }
  const occupied = range(startSlot, startSlot+durSlots-1);

  for(const s of occupied){
    const conflict = state.assignments.find(a=>a.id!==excludeId && a.personId===personId && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s));
    if(conflict){
      return { ok:false, reason:`${personName(personId)} is already scheduled for ${positionName(conflict.positionId)} at ${slots[s].label}.`, conflictAssignmentId: conflict.id };
    }
  }

  const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===positionId);
  if(pos && pos.singlePerson){
    for(const s of occupied){
      const conflict = state.assignments.find(a=>a.id!==excludeId && a.positionId===positionId && a.personId!==personId && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s));
      if(conflict){
        return { ok:false, reason:`${pos.name} allows only one person at a time — already filled by ${personName(conflict.personId)} at ${slots[s].label}.`, conflictAssignmentId: conflict.id };
      }
    }
  }

  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='required' || rule.effect!=='forbid') continue;

    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      const relType = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      let violated = false;
      if(relType==='sequence') violated = violatesSequenceRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied, excludeId);
      else if(relType==='together') violated = violatesTogetherRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied, excludeId);
      else if(relType==='consecutive') violated = violatesConsecutiveRule(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots, excludeId);
      else if(relType==='totalLimit') violated = violatesTotalLimitRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied, excludeId);
      else if(relType==='crossSchedule') violated = violatesCrossScheduleRule(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots);
      else if(relType==='swap') violated = violatesSwapRule(rule, personId, positionId, occupied, excludeId);
      if(violated) return { ok:false, reason: ruleLabel(rule), rule, highlights: describeHighlights(rule, personId, positionId, occupied) };
      continue;
    }

    if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) continue;
    if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) continue;
    for(const s of occupied){
      if(slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, s)){
        return { ok:false, reason: ruleLabel(rule), rule, highlights: describeHighlights(rule, personId, positionId, occupied) };
      }
    }
  }
  return { ok:true };
}

/* Validate resizing an EXISTING assignment to a new slot count (drag-to-resize). */
function isValidResize(assignmentId, newSlotCount){
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===assignmentId);
  if(!a) return { ok:false, reason:'Assignment not found.' };
  const minSlots = positionMinDurationSlots(a.positionId);
  const maxSlots = positionMaxDurationSlots(a.positionId);
  if(newSlotCount<minSlots || newSlotCount>maxSlots){
    return { ok:false, reason:`${positionName(a.positionId)} must be between ${minSlots*SLOT_MINUTES} and ${maxSlots*SLOT_MINUTES} minutes.` };
  }
  return isValidPlacement(a.personId, a.positionId, a.startSlot, { durSlots:newSlotCount, excludeAssignmentId:a.id });
}
function resizeAssignment(assignmentId, newSlotCount){
  const check = isValidResize(assignmentId, newSlotCount);
  if(!check.ok) return false;
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===assignmentId);
  a.slotCount = newSlotCount;
  return true;
}

/* ---------------- Preferred-rule matching (soft/suggestion side) ---------------- */
function matchesSequencePreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots){
  if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
  const order = rule.relative.order || 'after';
  const maxGap = rule.relative.maxGapMinutes;
  const otherTarget = rule.relative.otherPosition || {mode:'any'};
  const candStart = occupiedSlots[0], candEnd = occupiedSlots[occupiedSlots.length-1];
  return state.assignments.some(a=>{
    if(a.personId!==personId) return false;
    if(!positionMatchesTarget(otherTarget, a.positionId)) return false;
    const aStart=a.startSlot, aEnd=a.startSlot+a.slotCount-1;
    if(order==='after') return orderRelationHolds(aEnd, candStart, maxGap);
    if(order==='before') return orderRelationHolds(candEnd, aStart, maxGap);
    return orderRelationHolds(aEnd, candStart, maxGap) || orderRelationHolds(candEnd, aStart, maxGap);
  });
}
function matchesTogetherPreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occupiedSlots){
  const otherTarget = rule.relative.otherPerson || {mode:'any'};
  const matchesPrimary = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId);
  const matchesOther = personMatchesTarget(otherTarget, personId);
  if(!matchesPrimary && !matchesOther) return false;
  if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
  const counterpartTarget = matchesPrimary ? otherTarget : rule.person;
  const counterpartIds = state.people.filter(p=>p.id!==personId && personMatchesTarget(counterpartTarget, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
  return state.assignments.some(a=>counterpartIds.includes(a.personId) && a.positionId===positionId && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>occupiedSlots.includes(s)));
}
function preferredMatchesFor(personId, positionId, startSlot){
  const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
  const occ = range(startSlot, startSlot+durSlots-1);
  return state.rules.filter(rule=>{
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='preferred' || rule.effect!=='require') return false;
    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      const t = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      if(t==='sequence') return matchesSequencePreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ);
      if(t==='together') return matchesTogetherPreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ);
      return false;
    }
    if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, personId)) return false;
    if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, positionId)) return false;
    return occ.some(s=>slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, s));
  });
}

/* ---------------- Violations / coverage ---------------- */
function computeViolations(){
  const out = [];
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active) continue;

    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      if(rule.effect!=='forbid') continue; // required+require relative rules aren't auto-checked for coverage (see docs)
      const relType = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      for(const a of state.assignments){
        const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
        let violated = false;
        if(relType==='sequence') violated = violatesSequenceRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        else if(relType==='together') violated = violatesTogetherRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        else if(relType==='consecutive') violated = violatesConsecutiveRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, a.startSlot, a.slotCount, a.id);
        else if(relType==='totalLimit') violated = violatesTotalLimitRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        else if(relType==='crossSchedule') violated = violatesCrossScheduleRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, a.startSlot, a.slotCount);
        else if(relType==='swap') violated = violatesSwapRule(rule, a.personId, a.positionId, occ, a.id);
        if(violated && rule.strength==='required') out.push({ rule, assignment:a, kind:'forbidden-but-scheduled' });
      }
      continue;
    }

    if(rule.effect==='forbid'){
      for(const a of state.assignments){
        if(!personMatchesTarget(rule.person, a.personId)) continue;
        if(!positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId)) continue;
        const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
        const targets = new Set(targetSlotIndices(rule.slot, totalSlots));
        if(occ.some(s=>targets.has(s))){
          out.push({ rule, assignment:a, kind:'forbidden-but-scheduled' });
        }
      }
    } else if(rule.effect==='require' && rule.strength==='required'){
      const targets = targetSlotIndices(rule.slot, totalSlots);
      const isAnyWithCount = rule.person && rule.person.mode==='any';
      const countRange = isAnyWithCount ? (rule.person.count || {min:1, max:1}) : null;
      for(const s of targets){
        const matchingPeople = new Set(
          state.assignments
            .filter(a=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, a.personId) && positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId) && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s))
            .map(a=>a.personId)
        );
        if(isAnyWithCount){
          if(matchingPeople.size < countRange.min) out.push({ rule, slot:s, kind:'uncovered' });
          else if(matchingPeople.size > countRange.max) out.push({ rule, slot:s, kind:'overcapacity' });
        } else if(matchingPeople.size < 1){
          out.push({ rule, slot:s, kind:'uncovered' });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage(){
  return computeViolations().filter(v=>v.kind==='uncovered').map(v=>({ rule:v.rule, slot:v.slot }));
}

/* Auto-materialize fully-specific required "must be scheduled" rules
   (exact person + exact position + exact slot, standard kind only) as
   confirmed assignments, so the chart reflects required rules immediately. */
function syncDirectRequiredAssignments(){
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='required' || rule.effect!=='require' || rule.kind==='relative') continue;
    if(rule.person.mode!=='id' || rule.position.mode!=='id' || rule.slot.mode!=='id') continue;
    const already = state.assignments.some(a=>
      a.personId===rule.person.value && a.positionId===rule.position.value &&
      assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(rule.slot.value));
    if(already) continue;
    const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(rule.position.value);
    const starts = candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget({mode:'id', value:rule.slot.value}, durSlots, totalSlots);
    for(const startSlot of starts){
      const check = isValidPlacement(rule.person.value, rule.position.value, startSlot);
      if(check.ok){
        state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:rule.person.value, positionId:rule.position.value, startSlot, slotCount:durSlots });
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ---------------- Suggestions (preferred rules) ---------------- */
function computeSuggestions(){
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  const seen = new Map();
  function tryAdd(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot){
    const key = `${personId}|${positionId}|${startSlot}`;
    if(state.rejectedSuggestions.has(key)) return;
    const check = isValidPlacement(personId, positionId, startSlot);
    if(!check.ok) return;
    const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
    if(!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, { key, personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots, ruleIds:new Set() });
    seen.get(key).ruleIds.add(rule.id);
  }

  for(const rule of state.rules){
    if(!rule.active || rule.strength!=='preferred' || rule.effect!=='require') continue;

    if(rule.kind==='relative'){
      const relType = rule.relative && rule.relative.type;
      if(relType!=='sequence' && relType!=='together') continue;
      const people = state.people.filter(p=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      const positions = state.positions.filter(p=>positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      for(const personId of people){
        for(const positionId of positions){
          const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
          for(const startSlot of range(0, totalSlots-durSlots)){
            const occ = range(startSlot, startSlot+durSlots-1);
            const already = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===personId && a.positionId===positionId && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>occ.includes(s)));
            if(already) continue;
            const matched = relType==='sequence'
              ? matchesSequencePreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ)
              : matchesTogetherPreferred(rule, personId, positionId, occ);
            if(matched) tryAdd(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot);
          }
        }
      }
      continue;
    }

    const targets = targetSlotIndices(rule.slot, totalSlots);
    const isAnyWithCount = rule.person && rule.person.mode==='any';
    const countMax = isAnyWithCount && rule.person.count ? rule.person.count.max : 1;
    for(const s of targets){
      const matchingCount = state.assignments.filter(a=>
        personMatchesTarget(rule.person, a.personId) &&
        positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, a.positionId) &&
        assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s)).length;
      if(matchingCount>=countMax) continue;
      const people = state.people.filter(p=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      const positions = state.positions.filter(p=>positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
      for(const personId of people){
        for(const positionId of positions){
          const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
          const starts = candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget({mode:'id', value:s}, durSlots, totalSlots);
          for(const startSlot of starts) tryAdd(rule, personId, positionId, startSlot);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return Array.from(seen.values()).map(v=>({ ...v, ruleIds: Array.from(v.ruleIds) }));
}

/* ---------------- Constraint hot-spots (decision prioritization) ---------------- */
function computeHotSpots(){
  const slots = getSlots();
  const results = [];
  for(const person of state.people){
    for(const slot of slots){
```
