      const covered = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(slot.index));
      if(covered) continue;
      let impact = 0;
      for(const rule of state.rules){
        if(!rule.active) continue;
        const personHit = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, person.id) ||
          (rule.kind==='relative' && rule.relative && rule.relative.otherPerson && personMatchesTarget(rule.relative.otherPerson, person.id));
        if(!personHit) continue;
        const slotHit = rule.kind==='relative' ? true : slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, slot.index);
        if(!slotHit) continue;
        let weight = 1;
        if(rule.position && rule.position.mode!=='id') weight += 1;
        if(rule.person && rule.person.mode!=='id') weight += 1;
        if(rule.kind==='relative') weight += 1;
        if(rule.strength==='required') weight += 1;
        impact += weight;
      }
      if(impact>0) results.push({ personId: person.id, slot: slot.index, impact });
    }
  }
  return results.sort((a,b)=>b.impact-a.impact).slice(0,8);
}

/* ---------------- Solver (required rules only) ---------------- */
function candidatesForCoverage(rule, slot){
  const totalSlots = getSlots().length;
  const people = state.people.filter(p=>personMatchesTarget(rule.person, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
  const positions = state.positions.filter(p=>positionMatchesTarget(rule.position, p.id)).map(p=>p.id);
  const out = [];
  for(const personId of people){
    for(const positionId of positions){
      const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(positionId);
      const starts = candidateStartSlotsForSlotTarget({mode:'id', value:slot}, durSlots, totalSlots);
      for(const startSlot of starts){
        const check = isValidPlacement(personId, positionId, startSlot);
        if(check.ok) out.push({ personId, positionId, startSlot, durSlots });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function shuffleArray(arr){
  const a = arr.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1; i>0; i--){
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
    const tmp = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = tmp;
  }
  return a;
}

function solve(mode){
  mode = mode || 'required';
  const sched = activeSchedule();

  if(mode==='unlocked' || mode==='all'){
    const before = sched.assignments.length;
    sched.assignments = sched.assignments.filter(a=>{
      if(mode==='all') return false;
      const occ = assignmentOccupiesSlots(a);
      return occ.some(s=>isCellLocked(sched, a.personId, s));
    });
    state.assignments = sched.assignments;
  }

  const respectLocks = mode==='unlocked';
  const randomize = mode!=='required';

  const MAX_ITER = 4000;
  let iter=0, filled=0;
  while(iter++ < MAX_ITER){
    const pairs = getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage();
    if(pairs.length===0) break;
    let best = null;
    const orderedPairs = randomize ? shuffleArray(pairs) : pairs;
    for(const pair of orderedPairs){
      let cands = candidatesForCoverage(pair.rule, pair.slot);
      if(respectLocks) cands = cands.filter(c=>!range(c.startSlot, c.startSlot+c.durSlots-1).some(s=>isCellLocked(sched, c.personId, s)));
      if(cands.length===0) continue;
      if(!best || cands.length<best.candidates.length) best = { pair, candidates: cands };
    }
    if(!best) break; // everything left is currently unsatisfiable
    let bestCand=null, bestScore=-1;
    const candList = randomize ? shuffleArray(best.candidates) : best.candidates;
    for(const cand of candList){
      const occ = range(cand.startSlot, cand.startSlot+cand.durSlots-1);
      let coverCount=0;
      for(const p of pairs){
        if(occ.includes(p.slot) && personMatchesTarget(p.rule.person, cand.personId) && positionMatchesTarget(p.rule.position, cand.positionId)) coverCount++;
      }
      const prefBonus = preferredMatchesFor(cand.personId, cand.positionId, cand.startSlot).length;
      const score = coverCount*10 + prefBonus;
      if(score>bestScore){ bestScore=score; bestCand=cand; }
    }
    state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:bestCand.personId, positionId:bestCand.positionId, startSlot:bestCand.startSlot, slotCount:bestCand.durSlots });
    filled++;
  }

  let prefFilled=0;
  if(mode!=='required'){
    let guard=0, progress=true;
    while(progress && guard++<3000){
      progress=false;
      let suggestions = computeSuggestions();
      if(respectLocks) suggestions = suggestions.filter(s=>!range(s.startSlot, s.startSlot+s.durSlots-1).some(sl=>isCellLocked(sched, s.personId, sl)));
      if(suggestions.length===0) break;
      const sug = randomize ? shuffleArray(suggestions)[0] : suggestions[0];
      state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:sug.personId, positionId:sug.positionId, startSlot:sug.startSlot, slotCount:sug.durSlots });
      prefFilled++; progress=true;
    }
  }

  const remaining = getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage().length;
  renderAll();
  const modeLabel = mode==='required' ? 'Fill required' : mode==='unlocked' ? 'Fill unlocked' : 'Fill all';
  let msg = `${modeLabel} — placed ${filled} required assignment${filled===1?'':'s'}`;
  if(mode!=='required') msg += ` and ${prefFilled} preferred assignment${prefFilled===1?'':'s'}`;
  msg += '.';
  msg += remaining ? ` ${remaining} required instance${remaining===1?'':'s'} still can't be satisfied — see red items in Decisions.` : ' All required rules satisfied.';
  if(mode==='required') msg += ' Preferred-rule suggestions are shown as stars — click one to accept.';
  showToast(msg);
}

/* ================================================================
   RENDERING
   ================================================================ */
function renderAll(){
  syncDirectRequiredAssignments();
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('db-header-title');
  if(titleEl) titleEl.textContent = `${sched.name} Schedule`;
  document.getElementById('db-header-sub').textContent =
    `${formatTime(state.settings.startMinutes)} – ${formatTime(state.settings.endMinutes)} · ${getSlots().length} × ${SLOT_MINUTES}-min slots`;
  const visibleCount = state.people.filter(p=>!p.hidden).length;
  document.getElementById('chart-range-note').textContent =
    `${visibleCount} people · ${state.positions.length} positions`;
  renderScheduleTabs();
  renderChart();
  renderDecisions();
  renderRules();
  renderHiddenPeopleControl();
  syncRightColumnHeight();
  persist();
}

/* Right column (decisions + settings button) is sized to match the chart's
   natural height, since the chart should never stretch to match a long
   decisions list — the decisions list scrolls internally instead. */
function syncRightColumnHeight(){
  const chartPanel = document.getElementById('chart-panel');
  const decisionsPanel = document.getElementById('decisions-panel');
  const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('btn-settings');
  if(!chartPanel || !decisionsPanel) return;
  const chartH = chartPanel.offsetHeight;
  if(!chartH) return;
  const rightCol = decisionsPanel.parentElement;
  const gap = rightCol ? (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(rightCol).gap) || 14) : 14;
  const settingsH = settingsBtn ? settingsBtn.offsetHeight : 0;
  const decisionsH = Math.max(120, chartH - settingsH - gap);
  decisionsPanel.style.height = decisionsH + 'px';
}

function renderHiddenPeopleControl(){
  const sel = document.getElementById('hidden-people-select');
  if(!sel) return;
  const hidden = state.people.filter(p=>p.hidden);
  if(hidden.length===0){
    sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">No people toggled off</option>`;
    sel.disabled = true;
    return;
  }
  sel.disabled = false;
  sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">${hidden.length} toggled off — select to restore</option>` +
    hidden.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">Restore ${escapeHtml(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
  sel.onchange = ()=>{
    if(sel.value){
      const p = state.people.find(x=>x.id===sel.value);
      if(p) p.hidden = false;
      renderAll();
    }
  };
}

function renderScheduleTabs(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('schedule-tabs');
  bar.innerHTML = '';
  state.schedules.forEach((sched, idx)=>{
    const tab = document.createElement('div');
    tab.className = 'db-tab' + (sched.id===state.activeScheduleId ? ' active' : '');
    tab.dataset.scheduleId = sched.id;
    tab.draggable = true;
    tab.title = sched.id===state.activeScheduleId ? 'Click for clone/delete options' : `Switch to ${sched.name}`;
    tab.innerHTML = `<span class="idx">${idx+1}</span><span class="name">${escapeHtml(sched.name)}</span>`;
    tab.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      if(sched.id===state.activeScheduleId) openTabMenu(e, sched.id);
      else setActiveSchedule(sched.id);
    });
    tab.addEventListener('dragstart', ()=>{ tab.classList.add('dragging'); tab.__dragId = sched.id; window.__dbDragScheduleId = sched.id; });
    tab.addEventListener('dragend', ()=>{ tab.classList.remove('dragging'); });
    tab.addEventListener('dragover', (e)=>{ e.preventDefault(); });
    tab.addEventListener('drop', (e)=>{
      e.preventDefault();
      const fromId = window.__dbDragScheduleId;
      if(fromId) reorderSchedule(fromId, sched.id);
    });
    bar.appendChild(tab);
  });
}

function layoutSuggestionStars(starEls){
  const n = starEls.length;
  const set = (el,left,topPct)=>{ el.style.left=left; el.style.top=topPct+'%'; el.style.transform='translateY(-50%)'; };
  if(n===1){ set(starEls[0],'3px',50); }
  else if(n===2){ set(starEls[0],'3px',26); set(starEls[1],'3px',74); }
  else if(n===3){ set(starEls[0],'3px',20); set(starEls[1],'3px',80); set(starEls[2],'15px',50); }
  else{
    const leftCount = Math.ceil(n/2);
    for(let idx=0; idx<n; idx++){
      const col = idx<leftCount ? 0 : 1;
      const rowIdx = col===0 ? idx : idx-leftCount;
      const rowsInCol = col===0 ? leftCount : (n-leftCount);
      const topPct = rowsInCol<=1 ? 50 : (rowIdx/(rowsInCol-1))*70+15;
      set(starEls[idx], (3+col*12)+'px', topPct);
    }
  }
}

function renderChart(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('chart-grid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  const slots = getSlots();
  const visiblePeople = state.people.filter(p=>!p.hidden);
  const sched = activeSchedule();

  const scrollEl = document.querySelector('#chart-panel .db-chart-scroll');
  if(scrollEl) scrollEl.classList.toggle('full-view', fullViewMode);
  grid.classList.toggle('full-view', fullViewMode);
  let colWidth = 46;
  if(fullViewMode && scrollEl){
    const available = scrollEl.clientWidth - rowLabelWidth - 32;
    if(available>0) colWidth = Math.max(10, Math.min(46, Math.floor(available / Math.max(1,slots.length))));
  }
  grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `${rowLabelWidth}px repeat(${slots.length}, ${fullViewMode ? `minmax(${colWidth}px, 1fr)` : `${colWidth}px`})`;
  grid.style.gridTemplateRows = `48px repeat(${visiblePeople.length}, 40px)`;

  const corner = document.createElement('div');
  corner.className = 'db-corner';
  corner.textContent = `${visiblePeople.length} people`;
  grid.appendChild(corner);

  slots.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const showLabel = isHourMark(s,i);
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'db-time-head' + (showLabel ? ' hour-start' : '');
    el.style.gridColumn = `${i+2}`;
    el.style.gridRow = '1';
    el.title = `${s.label} — click for options`;
    el.dataset.slot = i;
    if(showLabel){
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'time-label';
      span.textContent = formatTimeShort(s.minutes);
      el.appendChild(span);
    }
    if(sched.lockedSlots.has(i)){
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'db-lock-badge';
      badge.textContent = '🔒';
      el.appendChild(badge);
    }
    el.addEventListener('click', (e)=>openTimeHeadPopup(e, i));
    grid.appendChild(el);
  });

  visiblePeople.forEach((p,pi)=>{
    const label = document.createElement('div');
    label.className = 'db-row-label';
    label.style.gridColumn = '1';
    label.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
    label.dataset.personId = p.id;
    const lockBadge = sched.lockedPeople.has(p.id) ? '<span class="db-lock-badge">🔒</span>' : '';
    label.innerHTML = `${lockBadge}<div class="name">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div><div class="tags${showPersonTags?'':' tags-hidden'}">${p.tags.map(t=>tagChipHtml(t)).join('')}</div>`;
    label.addEventListener('click', (e)=>openPersonPopup(e, p.id));
    grid.appendChild(label);

    slots.forEach((s,si)=>{
      const cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'db-cell' + (isHourMark(s,si) ? ' hour-start' : '');
      cell.style.gridColumn = `${si+2}`;
      cell.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
      cell.dataset.person = p.id;
      cell.dataset.slot = si;
      cell.title = `${p.name} · ${s.label} — click to assign`;
      if(sched.lockedCells.has(cellKeyFor(p.id, si)) && !sched.lockedPeople.has(p.id) && !sched.lockedSlots.has(si)){
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'db-lock-badge';
        badge.textContent = '🔒';
        cell.appendChild(badge);
      }
      cell.addEventListener('click', (e)=>onCellClick(e, p.id, si));
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    });
  });

  // Resize handle for the name column, spans the full header+body height.
  const rowResizeHandle = document.createElement('div');
  rowResizeHandle.className = 'db-row-resize-handle';
  rowResizeHandle.style.gridRow = `1 / span ${visiblePeople.length+1}`;
  rowResizeHandle.title = 'Drag to resize the name column';
  rowResizeHandle.addEventListener('mousedown', startRowLabelResize);
  grid.appendChild(rowResizeHandle);

  const violations = computeViolations();

  state.assignments.forEach(a=>{
    const pi = visiblePeople.findIndex(p=>p.id===a.personId);
    if(pi<0) return;
    const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===a.positionId);
    if(!pos) return;
    const block = document.createElement('div');
    block.className = 'db-block confirmed';
    const isViolated = violations.some(v=>v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled' && v.assignment.id===a.id);
    if(isViolated) block.classList.add('rule-violated');
    block.style.gridColumn = `${a.startSlot+2} / span ${a.slotCount}`;
    block.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
    block.style.background = pos.color;
    block.style.color = pos.textColor || '#FFFFFF';
    block.textContent = pos.name;
    block.dataset.assignmentId = a.id;
    block.title = `${pos.name} · ${personName(a.personId)} · click to remove`;
    block.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); openAssignmentPopup(e, a); });
    if(pos.durationMin!==pos.durationMax){
      const handle = document.createElement('div');
      handle.className = 'resize-handle';
      handle.title = `Drag to resize (${pos.durationMin}-${pos.durationMax} min)`;
      handle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e)=>startResizeDrag(e, a.id));
      block.appendChild(handle);
    }
    grid.appendChild(block);
  });

  const suggestions = computeSuggestions();
  const grouped = new Map();
  suggestions.forEach(sug=>{
    const key = `${sug.personId}|${sug.startSlot}`;
    if(!grouped.has(key)) grouped.set(key, []);
    grouped.get(key).push(sug);
  });
  grouped.forEach((group, key)=>{
    const [personId, startSlotStr] = key.split('|');
    const startSlot = Number(startSlotStr);
    const pi = visiblePeople.findIndex(p=>p.id===personId);
    if(pi<0) return;
    const maxDur = Math.max(...group.map(g=>g.durSlots));
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'db-suggestion-box';
    box.style.gridColumn = `${startSlot+2} / span ${maxDur}`;
    box.style.gridRow = `${pi+2}`;
    box.title = `${group.length} suggestion${group.length===1?'':'s'} — click a star to accept or reject`;
    const starEls = [];
    group.forEach(sug=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===sug.positionId);
      if(!pos) return;
      const star = document.createElement('span');
      star.className = 'db-suggestion-star';
      star.style.color = pos.color;
      star.textContent = '★';
      star.title = `${pos.name} for ${personName(personId)}`;
      star.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); openSuggestionPopup(e, sug); });
      box.appendChild(star);
      starEls.push(star);
    });
    layoutSuggestionStars(starEls);
    grid.appendChild(box);
  });
}

/* ---------------- Drag-to-resize a position's in-schedule duration ---------------- */
function startResizeDrag(e, assignmentId){
  e.stopPropagation();
  e.preventDefault();
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===assignmentId);
  if(!a) return;
  const block = document.querySelector(`.db-block[data-assignment-id="${assignmentId}"]`);
  const rect = block ? block.getBoundingClientRect() : { width: 46*a.slotCount };
  const perSlotWidth = (rect.width || 46*a.slotCount) / a.slotCount;
  resizeDrag = { assignmentId, startX: e.clientX, startSlotCount: a.slotCount, perSlotWidth: perSlotWidth||46, lastValidSlotCount: a.slotCount };
  if(block) block.classList.add('resizing');
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', onResizeMouseUp);
}
function onResizeMouseMove(e){
  if(!resizeDrag) return;
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===resizeDrag.assignmentId);
  if(!a) return;
  const deltaPx = e.clientX - resizeDrag.startX;
  const deltaSlots = Math.round(deltaPx / resizeDrag.perSlotWidth);
  const minSlots = positionMinDurationSlots(a.positionId);
  const maxSlots = positionMaxDurationSlots(a.positionId);
  let candidate = Math.max(minSlots, Math.min(maxSlots, resizeDrag.startSlotCount + deltaSlots));
  const check = isValidResize(resizeDrag.assignmentId, candidate);
  if(check.ok){
    resizeDrag.lastValidSlotCount = candidate;
    const block = document.querySelector(`.db-block[data-assignment-id="${resizeDrag.assignmentId}"]`);
    if(block) block.style.gridColumn = `${a.startSlot+2} / span ${candidate}`;
  }
}
function onResizeMouseUp(){
  if(!resizeDrag) return;
  const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===resizeDrag.assignmentId);
  const finalCount = resizeDrag.lastValidSlotCount;
  document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onResizeMouseMove);
  document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onResizeMouseUp);
  resizeDrag = null;
  if(a && finalCount!==a.slotCount) a.slotCount = finalCount;
  renderAll();
}

/* ---------------- Drag-to-resize the name column width ---------------- */
function startRowLabelResize(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  rowLabelResizeDrag = { startX: e.clientX, startWidth: rowLabelWidth };
  const handle = e.currentTarget;
  if(handle) handle.classList.add('dragging');
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', onRowLabelResizeMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', onRowLabelResizeUp);
}
function onRowLabelResizeMove(e){
  if(!rowLabelResizeDrag) return;
  const delta = e.clientX - rowLabelResizeDrag.startX;
  rowLabelWidth = Math.max(90, Math.min(320, rowLabelResizeDrag.startWidth + delta));
  const grid = document.getElementById('chart-grid');
  if(grid && grid.style.gridTemplateColumns){
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = grid.style.gridTemplateColumns.replace(/^[\d.]+px/, `${rowLabelWidth}px`);
  }
}
function onRowLabelResizeUp(){
  document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onRowLabelResizeMove);
  document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onRowLabelResizeUp);
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-row-resize-handle.dragging').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('dragging'));
  rowLabelResizeDrag = null;
  renderChart();
}

function ruleNicknamePrefix(rule){
  return rule.nickname ? `<strong>${escapeHtml(rule.nickname)}</strong> — ` : '';
}

function renderDecisions(){
  const body = document.getElementById('decisions-body');
  body.innerHTML = '';
  const violations = computeViolations();

  violations.forEach(v=>{
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'db-violation-card';
    const tag = document.createElement('span');
    tag.className = 'tag';
    tag.textContent = v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled' ? 'Rule violated'
      : v.kind==='overcapacity' ? 'Required — over capacity' : 'Required — unfilled';
    const txt = document.createElement('div');
    txt.className = 'txt';
    if(v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled'){
      txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(v.rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(v.rule))} But ${escapeHtml(personName(v.assignment.personId))} is scheduled for ${escapeHtml(positionName(v.assignment.positionId))} at ${getSlots()[v.assignment.startSlot].label}.`;
    } else if(v.kind==='overcapacity'){
      txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(v.rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(v.rule))} Too many people at ${getSlots()[v.slot].label}.`;
    } else {
      txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(v.rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(v.rule))} Not yet covered at ${getSlots()[v.slot].label}.`;
    }
    card.appendChild(tag); card.appendChild(txt);
    card.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if(v.kind==='forbidden-but-scheduled') flashCell(v.assignment.personId, v.assignment.startSlot);
      else flashCell(null, v.slot);
    });
    body.appendChild(card);
  });

  const pairs = getUnsatisfiedRequiredCoverage();
  const decisionItems = pairs
    .map(pair=>({ pair, count: candidatesForCoverage(pair.rule, pair.slot).length }))
    .sort((a,b)=>a.count-b.count)
    .slice(0,20);

  decisionItems.forEach(item=>{
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'db-decision-card';
    const top = document.createElement('div'); top.className = 'top-row';
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'count-badge' + (item.count===0 ? ' zero' : '');
    badge.textContent = item.count===0 ? '0 options' : `${item.count} option${item.count===1?'':'s'}`;
    top.appendChild(badge);
    card.appendChild(top);
    const txt = document.createElement('div'); txt.className = 'txt';
    txt.textContent = `${ruleLabel(item.pair.rule)} Needs coverage at ${getSlots()[item.pair.slot].label}.`;
    card.appendChild(txt);
    card.addEventListener('click', ()=>flashCell(null, item.pair.slot));
    body.appendChild(card);
  });

  const hotSpots = computeHotSpots();
  if(hotSpots.length){
    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.className = 'db-rules-section-title';
    title.textContent = 'Big decisions';
    body.appendChild(title);
    hotSpots.forEach(hs=>{
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'db-decision-card hotspot';
      const top = document.createElement('div'); top.className = 'top-row';
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'count-badge';
      badge.style.background = 'var(--preferred)';
      badge.textContent = `impact ${hs.impact}`;
      top.appendChild(badge);
      card.appendChild(top);
      const txt = document.createElement('div'); txt.className = 'txt';
      txt.textContent = `${personName(hs.personId)} @ ${getSlots()[hs.slot].label}`;
      card.appendChild(txt);
      card.addEventListener('click', ()=>flashCell(hs.personId, hs.slot));
      body.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  if(pairs.length===0 && violations.length===0 && hotSpots.length===0){
    const empty = document.createElement('div');
    empty.className = 'db-empty-note';
    empty.textContent = 'No open required decisions — all required coverage is satisfied.';
    body.appendChild(empty);
  }

  document.getElementById('decisions-note').textContent = `${violations.length} violated · ${pairs.length} open`;
}

function flashCell(personId, slotIndex){
  clearAllHighlights();
  let targets;
  if(personId) targets = document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-person="${personId}"][data-slot="${slotIndex}"]`);
  else targets = document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-slot="${slotIndex}"]`);
  targets.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('cell-flash'));
  if(targets[0]) targets[0].scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'nearest', inline:'center' });
  setTimeout(()=>{ targets.forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('cell-flash')); }, 1600);
}

/* ---------------- Rules list ---------------- */
function matchesDimFilter(target, filterVal){
  if(filterVal==='all') return true;
  const isAnyRestricted = target.mode==='any' && (((target.requiredTags||[]).length) || ((target.prohibitedTags||[]).length));
  if(filterVal==='unused') return target.mode==='any' && !isAnyRestricted;
  if(filterVal==='general') return target.mode==='tag' || target.mode==='range' || isAnyRestricted;
  if(filterVal==='specific') return target.mode==='id';
  return true;
}
function getFilteredRules(){
  const search = document.getElementById('rule-search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const fPerson = document.getElementById('filter-person').value;
  const fPosition = document.getElementById('filter-position').value;
  const fTime = document.getElementById('filter-time').value;
  const fRuleTag = document.getElementById('filter-rule-tag').value;
  const showRequired = document.getElementById('filter-required').checked;
  const showPreferred = document.getElementById('filter-preferred').checked;
  const showInactive = document.getElementById('filter-inactive').checked;

  return state.rules.filter(rule=>{
    if(rule.strength==='required' && !showRequired) return false;
    if(rule.strength==='preferred' && !showPreferred) return false;
    if(!rule.active && !showInactive) return false;
    if(!matchesDimFilter(rule.person, fPerson)) return false;
    if(!matchesDimFilter(rule.position, fPosition)) return false;
    if(!matchesDimFilter(rule.slot, fTime)) return false;
    if(fRuleTag!=='all' && !(rule.tags||[]).includes(fRuleTag)) return false;
    if(rulesFocusPersonId){
      const touchesFocus = personMatchesTarget(rule.person, rulesFocusPersonId) ||
        (rule.kind==='relative' && rule.relative && rule.relative.otherPerson && personMatchesTarget(rule.relative.otherPerson, rulesFocusPersonId));
      if(!touchesFocus) return false;
    }
    if(rulesFocusSlotIndex!==null){
      if(!slotMatchesTarget(rule.slot, rulesFocusSlotIndex)) return false;
    }
    if(search){
      const tagText = (rule.tags||[]).map(tid=>tagName(tid)).join(' ');
      const hay = (rule.nickname||'') + ' ' + ruleLabel(rule) + ' ' + tagText;
      if(!hay.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
}
function renderRules(){
  const body = document.getElementById('rules-body');
  body.innerHTML = '';

  const ruleTagSel = document.getElementById('filter-rule-tag');
  if(ruleTagSel){
    const currentVal = ruleTagSel.value;
    const ruleTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='rule');
    ruleTagSel.innerHTML = `<option value="all">All tags</option>` + ruleTags.map(t=>`<option value="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</option>`).join('');
    if(ruleTags.some(t=>t.id===currentVal)) ruleTagSel.value = currentVal;
  }

  if(rulesFocusPersonId || rulesFocusSlotIndex!==null){
    const chip = document.createElement('div');
    chip.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:10px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;';
    const label = rulesFocusPersonId
      ? `Showing rules for <strong style="color:var(--ink);">${escapeHtml(personName(rulesFocusPersonId))}</strong>`
      : `Showing rules touching <strong style="color:var(--ink);">${getSlots()[rulesFocusSlotIndex].label}</strong>`;
    chip.innerHTML = label;
    const clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
    clearBtn.className = 'btn btn-sm';
    clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear';
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ rulesFocusPersonId = null; rulesFocusSlotIndex = null; renderRules(); });
    chip.appendChild(clearBtn);
    body.appendChild(chip);
  }

  const filtered = getFilteredRules();
  const violations = computeViolations();
  const required = filtered.filter(r=>r.strength==='required');
  const preferred = filtered.filter(r=>r.strength==='preferred');

  const section = (title, rules)=>{
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'db-rules-section-title';
    h.textContent = `${title} (${rules.length})`;
    body.appendChild(h);
    if(rules.length===0){
      const e = document.createElement('div');
      e.className = 'db-empty-note';
      e.textContent = 'No rules match the current filters.';
      body.appendChild(e);
      return;
    }
    rules.forEach(rule=>body.appendChild(renderRuleRow(rule, violations)));
  };
  section('Required rules', required);
  section('Preferred rules', preferred);

  document.getElementById('rules-count-note').textContent = `${filtered.length} / ${state.rules.length} shown`;
}
function renderRuleRow(rule, violations){
  const isViolated = violations.some(v=>v.rule.id===rule.id);
  const row = document.createElement('div');
  row.className = 'db-rule-row' + (isViolated ? ' violated' : '') + (!rule.active ? ' inactive' : '');

  const chip = document.createElement('span');
  chip.className = 'effect-chip ' + rule.effect;
  chip.textContent = rule.effect==='forbid' ? 'FORBID' : 'REQUIRE';
  row.appendChild(chip);

  if(rule.kind==='relative'){
    const relChip = document.createElement('span');
    relChip.className = 'effect-chip';
    relChip.style.background = '#EDE9FE'; relChip.style.color = '#5B21B6';
    relChip.textContent = 'RELATIVE';
    row.appendChild(relChip);
  }

  const main = document.createElement('div'); main.className = 'rule-main';
  const txt = document.createElement('div'); txt.className = 'rule-text';
  txt.innerHTML = `${ruleNicknamePrefix(rule)}${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(rule))}`;
  main.appendChild(txt);
  const meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className = 'rule-meta';
  (rule.tags||[]).forEach(tid=>{
    const html = tagChipHtml(tid);
    if(html){
      const wrap = document.createElement('span');
      wrap.innerHTML = html;
      meta.appendChild(wrap.firstChild);
    }
  });
  if(isViolated){
    const w = document.createElement('span');
    w.className = 'db-tag-chip';
    w.style.color = 'var(--danger)'; w.style.background = 'var(--danger-soft)';
    w.textContent = 'violated';
    meta.appendChild(w);
  }
  main.appendChild(meta);
  row.appendChild(main);

  const actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'rule-actions';
  const sw = document.createElement('label');
  sw.className = 'db-switch';
  sw.title = rule.active ? 'Active (click to deactivate)' : 'Inactive (click to activate)';
  sw.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" ${rule.active?'checked':''}/><span class="track"></span><span class="thumb"></span>`;
  sw.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ rule.active = e.target.checked; renderAll(); });
  actions.appendChild(sw);

  const editBtn = document.createElement('button');
  editBtn.className = 'db-icon-btn'; editBtn.textContent = '✎'; editBtn.title = 'Edit rule';
  editBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>openSettings('rules', rule.id));
  actions.appendChild(editBtn);

  const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
  delBtn.className = 'db-icon-btn'; delBtn.textContent = '🗑'; delBtn.title = 'Delete rule';
  delBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(confirm('Delete this rule? This cannot be undone.')){
      state.rules = state.rules.filter(r=>r.id!==rule.id);
      renderAll();
    }
  });
  actions.appendChild(delBtn);

  row.appendChild(actions);
  return row;
}

/* ================================================================
   FLOATING UI: dropdown, popups, tab menu
   ================================================================ */
let currentCloser = null;
function registerCloser(fn){
  if(currentCloser) document.removeEventListener('mousedown', currentCloser);
  currentCloser = fn;
  setTimeout(()=>document.addEventListener('mousedown', currentCloser), 0);
}
function closeFloating(){
  document.getElementById('floating-layer').innerHTML = '';
  if(currentCloser){ document.removeEventListener('mousedown', currentCloser); currentCloser = null; }
}
function positionFloating(el, rect){
  const margin = 8;
  const w = el.offsetWidth || 260, h = el.offsetHeight || 120;
  let left = rect.left, top = rect.bottom + margin;
  if(left+w > window.innerWidth-margin) left = window.innerWidth-margin-w;
  if(top+h > window.innerHeight-margin) top = rect.top-h-margin;
  if(left<margin) left = margin;
  if(top<margin) top = margin;
  el.style.left = `${left}px`;
  el.style.top = `${top}px`;
}
function clearAllHighlights(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.cell-flash, .highlight-red').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('cell-flash','highlight-red'));
}
function applyOptionHighlight(opt, personId, slotIndex){
  clearAllHighlights();
  if(opt.conflictAssignmentId){
    const block = document.querySelector(`[data-assignment-id="${opt.conflictAssignmentId}"]`);
    if(block) block.classList.add('cell-flash');
    range(slotIndex, slotIndex+opt.durSlots-1).forEach(c=>{
      document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-person="${personId}"][data-slot="${c}"]`).forEach(el=>el.classList.add('cell-flash'));
    });
    return;
  }
  const h = opt.highlights;
  if(!h) return;
  h.personIds.forEach(pid=>{
    const row = document.querySelector(`.db-row-label[data-person-id="${pid}"]`);
    if(row) row.classList.add('highlight-red');
  });
  h.slots.forEach(s=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(`.db-cell[data-person="${personId}"][data-slot="${s}"]`).forEach(el=>el.classList.add('cell-flash'));
  });
  h.assignmentIds.forEach(aid=>{
    const block = document.querySelector(`[data-assignment-id="${aid}"]`);
    if(block) block.classList.add('cell-flash');
  });
  h.scheduleIds.forEach(sid=>{
    const tab = document.querySelector(`.db-tab[data-schedule-id="${sid}"]`);
    if(tab) tab.classList.add('highlight-red');
  });
}

function positionOptionsFor(personId, slotIndex){
  return state.positions.map(pos=>{
    const check = isValidPlacement(personId, pos.id, slotIndex);
    const durSlots = positionDurationSlots(pos.id);
    const prefMatches = check.ok ? preferredMatchesFor(personId, pos.id, slotIndex) : [];
    const history = historicalRatio(personId, pos.id, slotIndex);
    return { position:pos, ok:check.ok, reason:check.reason, conflictAssignmentId:check.conflictAssignmentId, highlights:check.highlights, starred: prefMatches.length>0, durSlots, history };
  });
}

function onCellClick(e, personId, slotIndex){
  closeFloating();
  openAssignDropdown(e, personId, slotIndex);
}

function findLockBadgeEl(kind, key){
  if(kind==='person') return document.querySelector(`.db-row-label[data-person-id="${key}"] .db-lock-badge`);
  if(kind==='slot') return document.querySelector(`.db-time-head[data-slot="${key}"] .db-lock-badge`);
  if(kind==='cell'){
    const [pid,slot] = String(key).split('|');
    return document.querySelector(`.db-cell[data-person="${pid}"][data-slot="${slot}"] .db-lock-badge`);
  }
  return null;
}
function flashLockIcon(kind, key){
  if(lockDisplayMode) return;
  const el = findLockBadgeEl(kind, key);
  if(!el) return;
  el.classList.remove('flash-show');
  void el.offsetWidth; // force reflow so a repeated flash restarts the animation
  el.classList.add('flash-show');
  setTimeout(()=>{ el.classList.remove('flash-show'); }, 2700);
}
function showSingleLockIcon(kind, key){
  hideLockIcons();
  const el = findLockBadgeEl(kind, key);
  if(el) el.classList.add('force-show');
}
function hideLockIcons(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-lock-badge.force-show').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('force-show'));
}

function openAssignDropdown(e, personId, slotIndex){
  const layer = document.getElementById('floating-layer');
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dd = document.createElement('div');
  dd.className = 'db-dropdown';
  const options = positionOptionsFor(personId, slotIndex);
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  const cellKey = cellKeyFor(personId, slotIndex);
  const cellLocked = sched.lockedCells.has(cellKey);
  dd.innerHTML = `<div class="db-dropdown-head db-option-head-actions">
      <span>${escapeHtml(personName(personId))} · ${getSlots()[slotIndex].label}</span>
      <button class="db-option-lock-toggle ${cellLocked?'on':''}" id="dd-lock-cell" title="${cellLocked?'Unlock this cell':'Lock this cell'}">🔒</button>
    </div><div class="db-dropdown-list"></div>`;
  const lockCellBtn = dd.querySelector('#dd-lock-cell');
  lockCellBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const wasLocked = sched.lockedCells.has(cellKey);
    if(wasLocked) sched.lockedCells.delete(cellKey);
    else sched.lockedCells.add(cellKey);
    closeFloating();
    renderAll();
    if(!wasLocked) flashLockIcon('cell', cellKey);
  });
  lockCellBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>showSingleLockIcon('cell', cellKey));
  lockCellBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideLockIcons);
  const list = dd.querySelector('.db-dropdown-list');
  options.forEach(opt=>{
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'db-option ' + (opt.ok ? 'ok' : 'blocked');
    const durText = opt.position.durationMin===opt.position.durationMax
      ? `${opt.position.durationMin}m` : `${opt.position.durationMin}-${opt.position.durationMax}m`;
    const historyText = opt.history ? `<span class="history-ratio">${opt.history.matches}/${opt.history.total}</span>` : '';
    row.innerHTML = `<span class="dot" style="background:${opt.position.color}"></span>
      <span class="label">${escapeHtml(opt.position.name)}${opt.starred?' <span class="star-mark">★</span>':''}</span>
      ${historyText}
      <span class="dur">${durText}</span>`;
    if(opt.ok){
      row.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId, positionId:opt.position.id, startSlot:slotIndex, slotCount:opt.durSlots });
        closeFloating();
        renderAll();
      });
    } else {
      row.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>{
        const tip = document.createElement('div');
        tip.className = 'db-option-tooltip';
        tip.textContent = opt.reason;
        row.appendChild(tip);
        applyOptionHighlight(opt, personId, slotIndex);
      });
      row.addEventListener('mouseleave', ()=>{
        const tip = row.querySelector('.db-option-tooltip');
        if(tip) tip.remove();
        clearAllHighlights();
      });
    }
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
  layer.appendChild(dd);
  positionFloating(dd, rect);
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!dd.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function openSuggestionPopup(e, sug){

    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-reject">Reject</button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="pop-accept">Accept</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);

  pop.querySelector('#pop-accept').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:sug.personId, positionId:sug.positionId, startSlot:sug.startSlot, slotCount:sug.durSlots });

  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });

function openPersonPopup(e, personId){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = document.getElementById('floating-layer');
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pop = document.createElement('div');
  pop.className = 'db-popup';
  const person = state.people.find(p=>p.id===personId);
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  const locked = sched.lockedPeople.has(personId);
  const tagsHtml = person.tags.map(t=>tagChipHtml(t)).join(' ') || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">No tags</span>';
  const namesArmed = pendingSwap && pendingSwap.mode==='names';
  const rowsArmed = pendingSwap && pendingSwap.mode==='rows';
  const namesLabel = namesArmed ? `Swap names: ${escapeHtml(personName(pendingSwap.personId))}` : 'Swap names';
  const rowsLabel = rowsArmed ? `Swap rows: ${escapeHtml(personName(pendingSwap.personId))}` : 'Swap rows';
  pop.innerHTML = `<div class="title">${escapeHtml(person.name)}</div>
    <div class="rule-hint">${tagsHtml}</div>
    <div class="row"><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-lock-person">${locked?'Unlock row':'Lock row'}</button><button class="btn btn-sm" id="pop-toggle-person">Toggle person</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm ${namesArmed?'armed':''}" id="pop-swap-names">${namesLabel}</button><button class="btn btn-sm ${rowsArmed?'armed':''}" id="pop-swap-rows">${rowsLabel}</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="pop-show-rules" style="width:100%;">Show rules</button></div>`;
  layer.appendChild(pop);
  positionFloating(pop, rect);
  pop.querySelector('#pop-show-rules').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    rulesFocusPersonId = personId;
    closeFloating();
    renderRules();
    const panel = document.getElementById('rules-panel');
    if(panel.scrollIntoView) panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
  });
  const lockPersonBtn = pop.querySelector('#pop-lock-person');
  lockPersonBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const wasLocked = sched.lockedPeople.has(personId);
    if(wasLocked) sched.lockedPeople.delete(personId);
    else sched.lockedPeople.add(personId);
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
    if(!wasLocked) flashLockIcon('person', personId);
  });
  lockPersonBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', ()=>showSingleLockIcon('person', personId));
  lockPersonBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideLockIcons);
  pop.querySelector('#pop-toggle-person').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    person.hidden = true;
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-swap-names').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(namesArmed){
      if(pendingSwap.personId!==personId) swapPersonNames(pendingSwap.personId, personId);
      pendingSwap = null;
    } else {
      pendingSwap = { mode:'names', personId };
    }
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  pop.querySelector('#pop-swap-rows').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(rowsArmed){
      if(pendingSwap.personId!==personId) swapPersonRows(pendingSwap.personId, personId);
      pendingSwap = null;
    } else {
      pendingSwap = { mode:'rows', personId };
    }
    closeFloating(); renderAll();
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!pop.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function swapPersonNames(idA, idB){
  const a = state.people.find(p=>p.id===idA), b = state.people.find(p=>p.id===idB);
  if(!a || !b) return;
  const tmp = a.name; a.name = b.name; b.name = tmp;
}
function swapPersonRows(idA, idB){
  state.assignments.forEach(asg=>{
    if(asg.personId===idA) asg.personId = idB;
    else if(asg.personId===idB) asg.personId = idA;
  });
}

function previewLockedForClone(){
  const sched = activeSchedule();
  document.getElementById('duty-board').classList.add('lock-preview-active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-row-label').forEach(el=>{
    if(sched.lockedPeople.has(el.dataset.personId)) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-time-head[data-slot]').forEach(el=>{
    if(sched.lockedSlots.has(Number(el.dataset.slot))) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-cell').forEach(el=>{
    const pid = el.dataset.person, s = Number(el.dataset.slot);
    if(isCellLocked(sched, pid, s)) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-block.confirmed').forEach(el=>{
    const a = state.assignments.find(x=>x.id===el.dataset.assignmentId);
    if(a && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).some(s=>isCellLocked(sched, a.personId, s))) el.classList.add('lock-preview');
  });
}
function clearLockPreview(){
  document.getElementById('duty-board').classList.remove('lock-preview-active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.lock-preview').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('lock-preview'));
}

function openSolveMenu(e){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = document.getElementById('floating-layer');
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const menu = document.createElement('div');
  menu.className = 'db-tab-menu';
  menu.innerHTML = `<button id="solve-fill-required">Fill required</button><button id="solve-fill-unlocked">Fill unlocked</button><button id="solve-fill-all">Fill all</button>`;
  layer.appendChild(menu);
  positionFloating(menu, rect);
  menu.querySelector('#solve-fill-required').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeFloating(); solve('required'); });
  const unlockedBtn = menu.querySelector('#solve-fill-unlocked');
  unlockedBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ clearLockPreview(); closeFloating(); solve('unlocked'); });
  unlockedBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', previewLockedForClone);
  unlockedBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', clearLockPreview);
  menu.querySelector('#solve-fill-all').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeFloating(); solve('all'); });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!menu.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

function openTabMenu(e, scheduleId){
  closeFloating();
  const layer = document.getElementById('floating-layer');
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  const menu = document.createElement('div');
  menu.className = 'db-tab-menu';
  menu.innerHTML = `<button id="tab-rename">Rename</button><button id="tab-clone-all">Clone all</button><button id="tab-clone-unlocked">Clone unlocked</button><button id="tab-delete" class="danger">Delete</button>`;
  layer.appendChild(menu);
  positionFloating(menu, rect);
  menu.querySelector('#tab-rename').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    const sched = state.schedules.find(s=>s.id===scheduleId);
    const next = prompt('Rename schedule', sched ? sched.name : '');
    if(next && next.trim() && sched){ sched.name = next.trim(); renderAll(); }
  });
  menu.querySelector('#tab-clone-all').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeFloating(); cloneActiveSchedule('all'); });
  const unlockedBtn = menu.querySelector('#tab-clone-unlocked');
  unlockedBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ clearLockPreview(); closeFloating(); cloneActiveSchedule('unlocked'); });
  unlockedBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', previewLockedForClone);
  unlockedBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', clearLockPreview);
  menu.querySelector('#tab-delete').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    closeFloating();
    if(confirm('Delete this schedule tab? This cannot be undone.')) deleteSchedule(scheduleId);
  });
  registerCloser((ev)=>{ if(!menu.contains(ev.target)) closeFloating(); });
}

/* ================================================================
   TOAST
   ================================================================ */
function showToast(msg){
  const layer = document.getElementById('toast-layer');
  layer.innerHTML = '';
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.className = 'db-toast';
  t.textContent = msg;
  layer.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(()=>{ t.remove(); }, 4800);
}

/* ================================================================
   SETTINGS MODAL
   ================================================================ */
let editingRuleId = null;

function openSettings(tab, editRuleId){
  document.getElementById('settings-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  editingRuleId = editRuleId || null;
  switchModalTab(tab || 'people');
}
function closeSettings(){
  document.getElementById('settings-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  editingRuleId = null;
}
function switchModalTab(tab){
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-modal-tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.tab===tab));
  const renderers = { people: renderPeopleTab, positions: renderPositionsTab, tags: renderTagsTab, rules: renderRulesTab, time: renderTimeTab };
  renderers[tab]();
}

/* ---- People tab ---- */
function renderPeopleTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const personTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='person');
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">People can be tagged with attributes (e.g. Male / Female / Bilingual) so rules can target a group instead of one individual. The roster below is shared by every schedule tab.</div>
    <table class="db-mini-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Tags</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="people-tbody"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="db-field grow"><label>New person name</label><input type="text" id="new-person-name" placeholder="e.g. Jordan"/></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="add-person-btn">Add person</button>
    </div>`;
  const tbody = document.getElementById('people-tbody');
  state.people.forEach(p=>{
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    const tagsHtml = personTags.map(t=>{
      const on = p.tags.includes(t.id);
      const style = on ? `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};` : '';
      return `<span class="db-chip-toggle ${on?'on':''}" style="${style}" data-person="${p.id}" data-tag="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span>`;
    }).join('');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</td><td><div class="db-chip-set">${tagsHtml || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">no person tags defined</span>'}</div></td><td><button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-person="${p.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('.db-chip-toggle').forEach(chip=>{
    chip.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const pid = chip.dataset.person, tid = chip.dataset.tag;
      const person = state.people.find(p=>p.id===pid);
      if(person.tags.includes(tid)) person.tags = person.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid);
      else person.tags.push(tid);
      renderPeopleTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-person]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const pid = btn.dataset.delPerson;
      if(!confirm('Delete this person? Their assignments will also be removed from every schedule.')) return;
      state.people = state.people.filter(p=>p.id!==pid);
      state.schedules.forEach(s=>{ s.assignments = s.assignments.filter(a=>a.personId!==pid); });
      state.assignments = activeSchedule().assignments;
      renderPeopleTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('add-person-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const input = document.getElementById('new-person-name');
    const name = input.value.trim();
    if(!name) return;
    state.people.push({ id:genId('p'), name, tags:[] });
    renderPeopleTab(); renderAll();
  });
}

/* ---- Positions tab ---- */
function wireColorHexPair(colorId, hexId, defaultValue){
  const colorEl = document.getElementById(colorId);
  const hexEl = document.getElementById(hexId);
  if(!colorEl || !hexEl) return;
  if(defaultValue){ colorEl.value = defaultValue; hexEl.value = defaultValue; }
  else hexEl.value = colorEl.value;
  colorEl.addEventListener('input', ()=>{ hexEl.value = colorEl.value; });
  hexEl.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
    if(/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(hexEl.value)) colorEl.value = hexEl.value;
    else hexEl.value = colorEl.value;
  });
}

function renderPositionsTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const posTags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.category==='position');
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">Positions occupy consecutive ${SLOT_MINUTES}‑minute slots. Give a position a duration range and its blocks on the chart can be dragged wider or narrower within that range; "Preferred" is the duration new assignments default to. "Single‑person" positions can only hold one person at a time; otherwise multiple people can share a position at once. Shared by every schedule tab.</div>
    <table class="db-mini-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Min</th><th>Preferred</th><th>Max</th><th>Single‑person</th><th>Fill color</th><th>Text color</th><th>Tags</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="positions-tbody"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="db-field"><label>New position name</label><input type="text" id="new-position-name" placeholder="e.g. Greeter"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Min duration (min)</label><input type="number" id="new-position-duration-min" value="${SLOT_MINUTES}" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Max duration (min)</label><input type="number" id="new-position-duration-max" value="${SLOT_MINUTES}" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Fill color</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-position-color"/><input type="text" id="new-position-color-hex" class="db-hex-input"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Text color</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-position-text-color"/><input type="text" id="new-position-text-color-hex" class="db-hex-input"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field checkbox"><input type="checkbox" id="new-position-single"/><label>Single‑person</label></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="add-position-btn">Add position</button>
    </div>`;
  wireColorHexPair('new-position-color', 'new-position-color-hex', '#3b6fd6');
  wireColorHexPair('new-position-text-color', 'new-position-text-color-hex', '#FFFFFF');
  const tbody = document.getElementById('positions-tbody');
  const inputStyle = 'width:58px;padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;';
  state.positions.forEach(pos=>{
    if(pos.preferredDuration===undefined) pos.preferredDuration = pos.durationMin;
    if(pos.textColor===undefined) pos.textColor = '#FFFFFF';
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    const tagsHtml = posTags.map(t=>{
      const on = pos.tags.includes(t.id);
      const style = on ? `background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};border-color:${t.highlightColor};` : '';
      return `<span class="db-chip-toggle ${on?'on':''}" style="${style}" data-position="${pos.id}" data-tag="${t.id}">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span>`;
    }).join('');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(pos.name)}</td>
      <td><input type="number" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}" value="${pos.durationMin}" data-dur-min="${pos.id}" style="${inputStyle}"/></td>
      <td><input type="number" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}" value="${pos.preferredDuration}" data-dur-pref="${pos.id}" style="${inputStyle}"/></td>
      <td><input type="number" min="${SLOT_MINUTES}" step="${SLOT_MINUTES}" value="${pos.durationMax}" data-dur-max="${pos.id}" style="${inputStyle}"/></td>
      <td><input type="checkbox" data-single="${pos.id}" ${pos.singlePerson?'checked':''}/></td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${pos.color}" data-color="${pos.id}"/><input type="text" value="${pos.color}" class="db-hex-input" data-color-hex="${pos.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${pos.textColor}" data-text-color="${pos.id}"/><input type="text" value="${pos.textColor}" class="db-hex-input" data-text-color-hex="${pos.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><div class="db-chip-set">${tagsHtml || '<span class="db-empty-note" style="padding:0;">no position tags defined</span>'}</div></td>
      <td><button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-position="${pos.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  function clampDuration(pos){
    pos.durationMin = Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Math.round(pos.durationMin/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    pos.durationMax = Math.max(pos.durationMin, Math.round(pos.durationMax/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    pos.preferredDuration = Math.min(pos.durationMax, Math.max(pos.durationMin, Math.round((pos.preferredDuration||pos.durationMin)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES));
  }
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-dur-min]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.durMin);
      pos.durationMin = Number(inp.value)||SLOT_MINUTES;
      clampDuration(pos);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-dur-max]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.durMax);
      pos.durationMax = Number(inp.value)||SLOT_MINUTES;
      clampDuration(pos);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-dur-pref]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.durPref);
      pos.preferredDuration = Number(inp.value)||pos.durationMin;
      clampDuration(pos);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-single]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.single).singlePerson = inp.checked;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.color);
      pos.color = inp.value;
      const hexTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-color-hex="${pos.id}"]`);
      if(hexTwin) hexTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-color-hex]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.colorHex);
      if(!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(inp.value)){ inp.value = pos.color; return; }
      pos.color = inp.value;
      const swatchTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-color="${pos.id}"]`);
      if(swatchTwin) swatchTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-text-color]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.textColor);
      pos.textColor = inp.value;
      const hexTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-text-color-hex="${pos.id}"]`);
      if(hexTwin) hexTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-text-color-hex]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===inp.dataset.textColorHex);
      if(!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(inp.value)){ inp.value = pos.textColor; return; }
      pos.textColor = inp.value;
      const swatchTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-text-color="${pos.id}"]`);
      if(swatchTwin) swatchTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('.db-chip-toggle').forEach(chip=>{
    chip.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const posId = chip.dataset.position, tid = chip.dataset.tag;
      const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.id===posId);
      if(pos.tags.includes(tid)) pos.tags = pos.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid);
      else pos.tags.push(tid);
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-position]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const posId = btn.dataset.delPosition;
      if(!confirm('Delete this position? Its assignments will also be removed from every schedule.')) return;
      state.positions = state.positions.filter(p=>p.id!==posId);
      state.schedules.forEach(s=>{ s.assignments = s.assignments.filter(a=>a.positionId!==posId); });
      state.assignments = activeSchedule().assignments;
      renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('add-position-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const name = document.getElementById('new-position-name').value.trim();
    if(!name) return;
    const durationMin = Math.max(SLOT_MINUTES, Math.round(Number(document.getElementById('new-position-duration-min').value)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    const durationMax = Math.max(durationMin, Math.round(Number(document.getElementById('new-position-duration-max').value)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES);
    const color = document.getElementById('new-position-color').value;
    const textColor = document.getElementById('new-position-text-color').value;
    const single = document.getElementById('new-position-single').checked;
    state.positions.push({ id:genId('pos'), name, durationMin, durationMax, preferredDuration:durationMin, singlePerson:single, color, textColor, tags:[] });
    renderPositionsTab(); renderAll();
  });
}

/* ---- Tags tab ---- */
function renderTagsTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const palette = nextTagPalette();
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">Tags classify people, positions, or rules (e.g. "Female", "Physically demanding", "Coverage") so rules can target a group instead of one individual, and so rules can be grouped for searching. Each tag's colors control how it's shown as a chip throughout the app.</div>
    <table class="db-mini-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Applies to</th><th>Highlight</th><th>Text</th><th>Preview</th><th>Used by</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="tags-tbody"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="db-field-row" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="db-field"><label>New tag name</label><input type="text" id="new-tag-name" placeholder="e.g. Bilingual"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Applies to</label>
        <select id="new-tag-category"><option value="person">People</option><option value="position">Positions</option><option value="rule">Rules</option></select>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Highlight</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-tag-highlight"/><input type="text" id="new-tag-highlight-hex" class="db-hex-input"/></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>Text</label>
        <div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" id="new-tag-text"/><input type="text" id="new-tag-text-hex" class="db-hex-input"/></div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="add-tag-btn">Add tag</button>
    </div>`;
  wireColorHexPair('new-tag-highlight', 'new-tag-highlight-hex', palette.bg);
  wireColorHexPair('new-tag-text', 'new-tag-text-hex', palette.text);
  const categoryLabel = c => c==='person' ? 'People' : c==='position' ? 'Positions' : 'Rules';
  const tbody = document.getElementById('tags-tbody');
  state.tags.forEach(t=>{
    const usageCount = t.category==='person'
      ? state.people.filter(p=>p.tags.includes(t.id)).length
      : t.category==='position'
        ? state.positions.filter(p=>p.tags.includes(t.id)).length
        : state.schedules.reduce((sum,s)=>sum + s.rules.filter(r=>(r.tags||[]).includes(t.id)).length, 0);
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(t.name)}</td>
      <td>${categoryLabel(t.category)}</td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${t.highlightColor}" data-tag-highlight="${t.id}"/><input type="text" value="${t.highlightColor}" class="db-hex-input" data-tag-highlight-hex="${t.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><div class="db-color-field"><input type="color" value="${t.textColor}" data-tag-text="${t.id}"/><input type="text" value="${t.textColor}" class="db-hex-input" data-tag-text-hex="${t.id}"/></div></td>
      <td><span class="db-tag-pill" id="tag-preview-${t.id}" style="background:${t.highlightColor};color:${t.textColor};">${escapeHtml(t.name)}</span></td>
      <td>${usageCount}</td>
      <td><button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-tag="${t.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-tag-highlight]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===inp.dataset.tagHighlight);
      t.highlightColor = inp.value;
      const preview = document.getElementById(`tag-preview-${t.id}`);
      if(preview) preview.style.background = inp.value;
      const hexTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-tag-highlight-hex="${t.id}"]`);
      if(hexTwin) hexTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-tag-highlight-hex]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===inp.dataset.tagHighlightHex);
      if(!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(inp.value)){ inp.value = t.highlightColor; return; }
      t.highlightColor = inp.value;
      const preview = document.getElementById(`tag-preview-${t.id}`);
      if(preview) preview.style.background = inp.value;
      const swatchTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-tag-highlight="${t.id}"]`);
      if(swatchTwin) swatchTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-tag-text]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===inp.dataset.tagText);
      t.textColor = inp.value;
      const preview = document.getElementById(`tag-preview-${t.id}`);
      if(preview) preview.style.color = inp.value;
      const hexTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-tag-text-hex="${t.id}"]`);
      if(hexTwin) hexTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-tag-text-hex]').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      const t = state.tags.find(x=>x.id===inp.dataset.tagTextHex);
      if(!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(inp.value)){ inp.value = t.textColor; return; }
      t.textColor = inp.value;
      const preview = document.getElementById(`tag-preview-${t.id}`);
      if(preview) preview.style.color = inp.value;
      const swatchTwin = tbody.querySelector(`[data-tag-text="${t.id}"]`);
      if(swatchTwin) swatchTwin.value = inp.value;
      renderAll();
    });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-tag]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const tid = btn.dataset.delTag;
      const usedByRules = state.schedules.some(s=>s.rules.some(r=>
        r.person.value===tid || r.position.value===tid || (r.tags||[]).includes(tid) ||
        (r.kind==='relative' && r.relative && (
          (r.relative.otherPosition && r.relative.otherPosition.value===tid) ||
          (r.relative.otherPerson && r.relative.otherPerson.value===tid)
        ))
      ));
      if(!confirm(`Delete this tag? It will be removed from all people/positions/rules${usedByRules ? ' — some rules reference it and will stop matching anything' : ''}.`)) return;
      state.tags = state.tags.filter(t=>t.id!==tid);
      state.people.forEach(p=>{ p.tags = p.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid); });
      state.positions.forEach(p=>{ p.tags = p.tags.filter(x=>x!==tid); });
      state.schedules.forEach(s=>{ s.rules.forEach(r=>{ r.tags = (r.tags||[]).filter(x=>x!==tid); }); });
      renderTagsTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('add-tag-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const name = document.getElementById('new-tag-name').value.trim();
    const category = document.getElementById('new-tag-category').value;
    const highlightColor = document.getElementById('new-tag-highlight').value;
    const textColor = document.getElementById('new-tag-text').value;
    if(!name) return;
    state.tags.push({ id:genId('tag'), name, category, highlightColor, textColor });
    renderTagsTab();
  });
}

/* ---- Time range tab ---- */
function renderTimeTab(){
  const body = document.getElementById('modal-body');
  const stepSeconds = SLOT_MINUTES*60;
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">Times snap to ${SLOT_MINUTES}‑minute slots. The time range is shared by every schedule tab; shrinking it removes any assignments (in any tab) that fall outside it.</div>
    <div class="db-field-row">
      <div class="db-field"><label>Start time</label><input type="time" id="range-start" value="${minutesToTimeInput(state.settings.startMinutes)}" step="${stepSeconds}"/></div>
      <div class="db-field"><label>End time</label><input type="time" id="range-end" value="${minutesToTimeInput(state.settings.endMinutes)}" step="${stepSeconds}"/></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="apply-range-btn">Apply</button>
    </div>
    <div class="db-rule-preview"><span class="lbl">Current range</span>${getSlots().length} slots · ${formatTime(state.settings.startMinutes)} – ${formatTime(state.settings.endMinutes)}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('apply-range-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const startVal = document.getElementById('range-start').value;
    const endVal = document.getElementById('range-end').value;
    if(!startVal || !endVal) return;
    let startMin = Math.round(timeInputToMinutes(startVal)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES;
    let endMin = Math.round(timeInputToMinutes(endVal)/SLOT_MINUTES)*SLOT_MINUTES;
    if(endMin<=startMin){ alert('End time must be after start time.'); return; }
    state.settings.startMinutes = startMin;
    state.settings.endMinutes = endMin;
    const totalSlots = Math.round((endMin-startMin)/SLOT_MINUTES);
    state.schedules.forEach(s=>{
      s.assignments = s.assignments.filter(a=>a.startSlot>=0 && a.startSlot+a.slotCount<=totalSlots);
    });
    state.assignments = activeSchedule().assignments;
    renderTimeTab(); renderAll();
  });
}

  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="db-help-text">"Any time" on a required rule applies to every slot, so "must be scheduled, any time" means required at every slot, and "cannot be scheduled, any time" means forbidden at every slot. Preferred rules generate star suggestions instead of hard blocks. Relative rules compare an assignment to other assignments (sequence, pairing, repetition, swaps) rather than to a fixed time. Rules are specific to this schedule tab.</div>
    <div class="db-rule-builder">

          <select id="rb-kind"><option value="standard">Standard</option><option value="relative">Relative</option></select>
        </div>

      <div class="db-field-row" id="rb-anyone-fields" style="display:none;">
        <div class="db-field grow"><label>Required tags (must have all)</label><div class="db-chip-set" id="rb-anyone-required-chips"></div></div>
        <div class="db-field grow"><label>Prohibited tags (must have none)</label><div class="db-chip-set" id="rb-anyone-prohibited-chips"></div></div>
        <div class="db-field" id="rb-anyone-count-wrap"><label>Count (min–max)</label>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">
            <input type="number" id="rb-anyone-count-min" value="1" min="1" step="1" style="width:60px;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;"/>
            <span style="color:var(--muted);">to</span>
            <input type="number" id="rb-anyone-count-max" value="1" min="1" step="1" style="width:60px;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:5px;"/>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field-row">
        <div class="db-field"><label>Position</label>
          <select id="rb-position-mode"><option value="any">Any position</option><option value="id">Specific position</option><option value="tag">Tag</option></select>
        </div>
        <div class="db-field" id="rb-position-value-wrap"><label>&nbsp;</label><select id="rb-position-value"></select></div>
      </div>
      <div class="db-field-row" id="rb-time-row">
        <div class="db-field"><label>Time</label>
          <select id="rb-slot-mode"><option value="any">Any time</option><option value="id">Specific slot</option><option value="range">Range</option></select>
        </div>
        <div class="db-field" id="rb-slot-value-wrap"><label>At</label><select id="rb-slot-value"></select></div>
        <div class="db-field" id="rb-slot-end-wrap" style="display:none;"><label>To</label><select id="rb-slot-end"></select></div>
      </div>

      <div class="db-relative-fields" id="rb-relative-section" style="display:none;">
        <div class="db-field-row">
          <div class="db-field"><label>Relative type</label>
            <select id="rb-relative-type">
              <option value="sequence">Before / after / near another position</option>
              <option value="together">Same time &amp; place as another person</option>
              <option value="consecutive">Times in a row (this schedule)</option>
              <option value="totalLimit">Total limit (whole schedule)</option>
              <option value="crossSchedule">Schedules in a row</option>
              <option value="swap">Mutual swap (X→Y while someone else Y→X)</option>
            </select>
